ex.cn: 他们的成功在很大程度上应归功于他们的决心。

senses.def: used to show surprise at seeing sb/sth

ex.en: I hadn't seen her for fifteen years and then there she was, (as) large as life.
ex.cn: 我有十五年未见过她，却在那里遇见她了，没错，就是她。

senses.def: looking or behaving in a way that is more interesting or exciting than other people, and so is likely to attract attention

ex.en: He's a larger than life character.
ex.cn: 他这个人不是一般的有趣，很招眼。

senses.def: used when you are saying something that is generally, but not completely, true

ex.en: By and large, I enjoyed my time at school.
ex.cn: 总的说来，我在学校的日子很开心。

ex.en: Women generally earn less than men.
ex.cn: 女人通常比男人挣钱少。

ex.en: Generally speaking, jobs traditionally done by women are paid at a lower rate than those traditionally done by men.
ex.cn: 一般来说，传统上由妇女干的工作比传统上由男人干的工作报酬低。

ex.en: In general / By and large, women do not earn as much as men.
ex.cn: 总的说来，女人不如男人挣钱多。

ex.en: Certain jobs, like nursing and cleaning, are still mainly carried out by women.
ex.cn: 有些工作仍然主要由女性做，比如护理和保洁。

ex.en: Senior management posts are predominantly held by men.
ex.cn: 高层管理职位大多由男性担任。

senses.def: to be worrying or frightening and seem hard to avoid
senses.chn: 令人忧虑，令人惊恐（并似乎难以避免）

ex.en: The prospect of war loomed large.
ex.cn: 战争的阴影在逼近，令人忧虑。

senses.def: easy to see or understand

ex.en: Mistrust was writ large on her face.
ex.cn: 她脸上明显流露出不信任的神情。

senses.def: being a large or obvious example of the thing mentioned

ex.en: This is deception writ large.
ex.cn: 这是明目张胆的欺骗。

senses.def: to enjoy yourself, especially by dancing and drinking alcohol
senses.chn: 玩个痛快；（尤指跳舞和饮酒）作乐

senses.def: to enjoy yourself, especially by dancing and drinking alcohol
senses.chn: 玩个痛快；（尤指跳舞和饮酒）作乐

senses.def: to enjoy yourself, especially by dancing and drinking alcohol
senses.chn: 玩个痛快；（尤指跳舞和饮酒）作乐

senses.def: to a great extent; mostly or mainly
senses.chn: 在很大程度上；多半；主要地

ex.en: the manager who is largely responsible for the team's victory
ex.cn: 对该队获胜起主要作用的主教练

ex.en: It was largely a matter of trial and error.
ex.cn: 这主要是个反复试验的问题。

ex.en: He resigned largely because of the stories in the press.
ex.cn: 他的辞职多半是因为新闻界的一些报道。

senses.def: looking or behaving in a way that is more interesting or exciting than other people, and so is likely to attract attention

ex.en: He's a larger than life character.
ex.cn: 他这个人不是一般的有趣，很招眼。

senses.def: involving many people or things, especially over a wide area
senses.chn: 大规模的；大批的；大范围的

ex.en: large-scale development
ex.cn: 大规模的开发

ex.en: the large-scale employment of women
ex.cn: 对女性大批的雇用

senses.def: drawn or made to a scale that shows a small area of land or a building in great detail
senses.chn: 按大比例绘制（或制作）的；大比例尺的

senses.def: the act or quality of being generous with money; money that you give to people who have less than you
senses.chn: 慷慨解囊；施舍；（给穷人的）钱，赠款

ex.en: She is not noted for her largesse (= she is not generous).
ex.cn: 她不以出手大方出名。

ex.en: to dispense largesse to the poor
ex.cn: 把钱施舍给穷人

senses.def: fairly large
in a slow, serious way
a piece of music to be performed in a slow, serious way
a small brown bird with a pleasant song
a thing that you do for fun or as a joke

ex.en: The boys didn't mean any harm—they just did it for a lark.
ex.cn: 那些男孩并无恶意，他们只是闹着玩罢了。

senses.def: an activity that you think is a waste of time or that you do not take seriously
senses.chn: （认为）浪费时间的活动；不受重视的活动

ex.en: Perhaps this riding lark would be more fun than she'd thought.
ex.cn: 也许这次骑马的无聊活动比她所想象的要好玩一些。

senses.def: to get out of bed very early in the morning
used by sb who does not want to do sth because it involves too much effort

ex.en: Sod that for a lark! I'm not doing any more tonight.
ex.cn: 拉倒吧！我今晚再也不做了。

senses.def: to enjoy yourself by behaving in a silly way
a tall garden plant with blue, pink or white flowers growing up its stem
senses.chn: 飞燕草（高株园艺植物，开蓝色、粉红或白色花）

senses.def: very smart; expensive

ex.en: We were invited to a larney function.
ex.cn: 我们获邀参加一个盛大的庆典。

ex.en: a larney hotel
ex.cn: 高档酒店

senses.def: the abbreviation for 'live action role-playing game'(= a type of game in which players pretend to be imaginary characters in a story, usually using special clothes and objects to make the story appear more real)
senses.chn: 真人角色扮演游戏（全写为 live action role-playing game）

senses.def: a person who ignores the normal rules of society or of an organization
senses.chn: 不守规矩的人；无视规章制度的人

senses.def: an insect at the stage when it has just come out of an egg and looks like a short fat worm
related to or produced by the larynx
an infection of the larynx that makes speaking painful
the area at the top of the throat that contains the vocal cords
large flat pieces of pasta
an Italian dish made from layers of lasagne, finely chopped meat and/or vegetables and white sauce
senses.chn: 意大利千层面（以多层宽面条夹肉末、蔬菜和白汁制成）

senses.def: feeling or showing strong sexual desire
senses.chn: 好色的；淫荡的；淫欲的；猥亵的

ex.en: a lascivious person
ex.cn: 淫荡的人

ex.en: lascivious thoughts
ex.cn: 淫猥的念头

senses.def: a device that gives out light in which all the waves oscillate (= change direction and strength) together, typically producing a powerful beam of light that can be used for cutting metal, in medical operations, etc.

ex.en: a laser beam
ex.cn: 激光束

ex.en: a laser navigation device
ex.cn: 激光导航装置

ex.en: The barcodes on the products are read by lasers.
ex.cn: 产品上的条码是用激光读取的。

ex.en: a laser show (= lasers used as entertainment)
ex.cn: 激光表演

ex.en: She's had laser surgery on her eye.
ex.cn: 她做了眼部激光手术。

senses.def: a plastic disc like a large CD on which large amounts of information, such as video or music, can be stored, and which can be read by a laser
a piece of equipment which uses a laser to read a barcode or to find out how fast a vehicle or other object is moving
senses.chn: 激光条码扫描仪；激光测速仪

senses.def: a printer that produces good quality printed material by means of a laser
to hit sb/sth with great force

ex.en: The rain lashed at the windows.
ex.cn: 雨点猛烈地打在窗户上。

ex.en: Huge waves lashed the shore.
ex.cn: 巨浪拍打着海岸。

ex.en: Someone was beating at the door.
ex.cn: 有人在打门。

ex.en: A young man was found beaten to death last night.
ex.cn: 昨天夜里有人发现一名小伙子被打死了。

ex.en: At that time, children were often beaten for quite minor offences(= as a punishment).
ex.cn: 那时候孩子们常常因为很小的过错而挨打。

ex.en: He had been badly battered around the head and face.
ex.cn: 他被打得鼻青脸肿。

senses.def: to hit a person or an animal with a whip, rope, stick, etc.
to criticize sb/sth in a very angry way
to fasten sth tightly to sth else with ropes

ex.en: Several logs had been lashed together to make a raft.
ex.cn: 几根原木捆扎在一起做成了木筏。

ex.en: During the storm everything on deck had to be lashed down.
ex.cn: 暴风雨中甲板上所有的东西都必须系牢。

senses.def: to move or to move sth quickly and violently from side to side

ex.en: The crocodile's tail was lashing furiously from side to side.
ex.cn: 鳄鱼的尾巴在急速地左右甩动。

senses.def: to suddenly try to hit sb/sth

ex.en: She suddenly lashed out at the boy.
ex.cn: 她突然狠狠地打那个男孩。

senses.def: to criticize sb in an angry way

ex.en: In a bitter article he lashed out at his critics.
ex.cn: 他写了一篇尖刻的文章，猛烈驳斥批评他的人。

senses.def: to spend a lot of money on sth
a hit with a whip, given as a form of punishment

ex.en: They each received 20 lashes for stealing.
ex.cn: 他们因盗窃每人挨了 20 鞭。

ex.en: to feel the lash of sb's tongue (= to be spoken to in an angry and critical way)
ex.cn: 领教某人言语如鞭的厉害

senses.def: the thin leather part at the end of a whip

example.en: The rain lashed at the windows.
example.cn: 雨点猛烈地打在窗户上。

example.en: Huge waves lashed the shore.
example.cn: 巨浪拍打着海岸。

senses.def: a large amount of sth, especially of food and drink
senses.chn: 大量，许多（尤指食物和饮料）

ex.en: a bowl of strawberries with lashings of cream
ex.cn: 一碗浇了大量奶油的草莓

senses.def: an act of hitting sb with a whip as a punishment

ex.en: He was given a severe tongue-lashing (= angry criticism).
ex.cn: 他受到了严厉的斥责。

senses.def: a rope used to fasten sth tightly to sth else
to spend a lot of money on sth
a girl; a young woman
a serious disease, usually caught from rats and found especially in W Africa
senses.chn: 拉沙热（常由鼠类传染，尤见于西非）

senses.def: a S Asian drink made from yogurt
a state of feeling very tired in mind or body; lack of energy
a long rope with one end tied into a loop that is used for catching horses, cows, etc.
to catch an animal using a lasso
happening or coming after all other similar things or people

ex.en: We caught the last bus home.
ex.cn: 我们赶上了回家的末班公共汽车。

ex.en: It's the last house on the left.
ex.cn: 是左边尽头那栋房子。

ex.en: She was last to arrive.
ex.cn: 她是最后到的。

senses.def: most recent

ex.en: last night/Tuesday/month/summer/year
ex.cn: 昨晚；上个星期二；上个月；去年夏季；去年

ex.en: her last book
ex.cn: 她最近出版的书

ex.en: This last point is crucial.
ex.cn: 刚讲的这一点是关键的。

ex.en: The last time I saw him was in May.
ex.cn: 我上次见到他是在五月份。

senses.def: only remaining

ex.en: This is our last bottle of water.
ex.cn: 这是我们最后的一瓶水了。

ex.en: He knew this was his last hope of winning.
ex.cn: 他知道这是他取胜的最后希望。

senses.def: used to emphasize that sb/sth is the least likely or suitable
senses.chn: （强调）最不可能的，最不适当的

ex.en: The last thing she needed was more work.
ex.cn: 她最不需要的就是更多的工作。

ex.en: He's the last person I'd trust with a secret.
ex.cn: 我要是有什么秘密，告诉谁也不能告诉他。

senses.def: to be going to die or stop functioning very soon; to be very weak or in bad condition
senses.chn: 濒临死亡；奄奄一息；行将就木；快不能用了

senses.def: the day, week, etc. just before the most recent one; two days, weeks, etc. ago
senses.chn: 前天；上上星期；上上月；两天（或两周等）以前

ex.en: I haven't seen him since the summer before last.
ex.cn: 我已有两个夏天没见过他了。

senses.def: every person or thing in a group

ex.en: We spent every last penny we had on the house.
ex.cn: 我们把所有的钱都花在房子上了。

senses.def: to be successful when you were not expected to be, making your opponents look stupid
senses.chn: （在本未指望时）笑在最后，取得最后胜利

senses.def: when there are no other possible courses of action

ex.en: In the last resort we can always walk home.
ex.cn: 顶多我们走回家就是了。

senses.def: the point at which you/sth can no longer continue living, fighting, existing, etc.
senses.chn: 奄奄一息；苟延残喘；临终；垂死

senses.def: the latest possible time before an important event
senses.chn: （重大事情前的）最后一刻，紧要关头

ex.en: They changed the plans at the last minute.
ex.cn: 事到临头他们却改变了计划。

ex.en: Don't leave your decision to the last moment.
ex.cn: 别等到最后一刻才来作决定。

senses.def: the person or thing you rely on when everything else has failed
senses.chn: 最后可依赖的人（或事物）

ex.en: I've tried everyone else and now you're my last resort.
ex.cn: 其他人我都试过了，现在就靠你了。

senses.def: the most recent, fashionable, advanced, etc. thing
senses.chn: 最新（或时髦、先进等）的事物

ex.en: These apartments are the last word in luxury.
ex.cn: 这些公寓最为豪华。

senses.def: used to say what is most important after everything has been discussed, or considered

ex.en: In the final analysis, it's a matter of personal choice.
ex.cn: 归根结底，这是个人的选择。

senses.def: the last moment of a person's life
people sometimes say Famous last words! when they think sb is being too confident about sth that is going to happen
senses.chn: 吹牛，胡扯（表示某人盲目乐观）

ex.en: 'Everything's under control.' 'Famous last words!'
ex.cn: “一切都在掌握之中。” “净吹牛！”

senses.def: after a long time

ex.en: At long last his prayers had been answered.
ex.cn: 他的祷告终于应验了。

senses.def: used to emphasize that sth is true of all the people being described

ex.en: They answered 'Yes,' to a man.
ex.cn: 他们异口同声地回答：“是。”

ex.en: They were all destroyed, to the last man.
ex.cn: 他们无一例外全部被歼。

senses.def: the last in a series of bad events, etc. that makes it impossible for you to accept a situation any longer
senses.chn: 压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草；终于使人不堪忍受的最后一件事（或因素等）

senses.def: early in the morning/late in the evening
senses.chn: 一早／晚上最后（要做的事）

ex.en: I need the report on my desk first thing Monday morning.
ex.cn: 星期一一早这个报告就得放在我的办公桌上。

senses.def: seven days before the day that you mention
senses.chn: 一个星期前的昨天（或星期一等）

ex.en: She started work a week yesterday.
ex.cn: 她在一个星期前的昨天就开始工作了。

senses.def: the last comment or decision about sth
senses.chn: （对某事的）最后意见，最后决定

ex.en: He always has to have the last word in any argument.
ex.cn: 在任何争论中总是得他最后说了算。

senses.def: after anyone or anything else; at the end

ex.en: He came last in the race.
ex.cn: 这次赛跑他得了最后一名。

ex.en: They arrived last of all.
ex.cn: 他们来得比谁都晚。

senses.def: most recently

ex.en: When did you see him last?
ex.cn: 你最后一次是什么时候见过他？

ex.en: I saw him last/I last saw him in New York two years ago.
ex.cn: 我上一次是两年前在纽约见到他的。

ex.en: They last won the cup in 2006.
ex.cn: 他们上一次获得奖杯是在 2006 年。

senses.def: used when mentioning the last person or thing of a group, in order to say that they are not less important than the others
senses.chn: （提及最后的人或事物时说）最后但同样重要的

ex.en: Last but not least, I'd like to thank all the catering staff.
ex.cn: 最后但同样重要的是，我要感谢所有的餐饮工作人员。

senses.def: used, for example in a situation when people are losing their jobs, to say that the last people to be employed will be the first to go
senses.chn: （形容裁员等情况）最后雇用的人最先被解雇，后来者先走

senses.def: in every way that is important; completely

ex.en: She regarded herself, first and last, as a musician.
ex.cn: 她认为她自己是一个不折不扣的音乐家。

senses.def: used to tell sb not to be too proud of their present success; in the end another person may be more successful
senses.chn: 别高兴得太早；笑到最后才笑得最好

senses.def: the person or thing that comes or happens after all other similar people or things
senses.chn: 最后来的人（或发生的事）

ex.en: Sorry I'm late—am I the last?
ex.cn: 对不起，我来晚了。我是最后到的人吗？

ex.en: They were the last to arrive.
ex.cn: 他们是最后到达的人。

senses.def: the latest

ex.en: That was the last I heard of him.
ex.cn: 那是我最后一次听到他的消息。

senses.def: the only remaining part or items of sth

ex.en: These are the last of our apples.
ex.cn: 这是我们最后剩下的几个苹果。

senses.def: the least likely

ex.en: 'I'll be the last to admit that I know anything about cars!', she said.
ex.cn: “我完全不敢说对汽车有多少认识！” 她说。

ex.en: Known for their self-sufficiency, fishermen would be the last to admit to mental strain.
ex.cn: 渔民以自给自足著称，最不可能承认有精神压力。

senses.def: after much delay, effort, etc.; in the end
senses.chn: （经过长时间的延误或努力等之后）终于，最终

ex.en: At last we're home!
ex.cn: 我们终于到家了！

ex.en: At long last the cheque arrived.
ex.cn: 支票终于到了。

ex.en: Lastly, I would like to thank my parents for all their support.
ex.cn: 最后，我想感谢父母对我的全力支持。

ex.en: At last, after twenty hours on the boat, they arrived at their destination.
ex.cn: 乘船二十小时之后，他们终于到达了目的地。

senses.def: to hear/see sb/sth for the last time

ex.en: That was the last I ever saw of her.
ex.cn: 那是我最后一次见到她。

ex.en: Unfortunately, I don't think we've heard the last of this affair.
ex.cn: 遗憾的是，我认为这件事还没有了结。

senses.def: used to give the most recent news you have about sb/sth
senses.chn: （提供最新消息时说）我最近听到的消息

ex.en: The last I heard he was still working at the garage.
ex.cn: 我最近听到的消息是他还在汽车修理厂工作。

senses.def: the one before the last one

ex.en: She finished second to last.
ex.cn: 她得了倒数第二。

senses.def: until the last possible moment, especially until death
senses.chn: 直到最后一刻；（尤指）直至死亡

ex.en: He died protesting his innocence to the last.
ex.cn: 他至死都坚决辩称自己无罪。

senses.def: to die
from beginning to end; during the whole time

ex.en: It's a fine performance that commands attention from first to last.
ex.cn: 这是个精彩的演出，自始至终都扣人心弦。

senses.def: to continue for a particular period of time

ex.en: The meeting only lasted (for) a few minutes.
ex.cn: 会议只开了几分钟。

ex.en: Each game lasts about an hour.
ex.cn: 每场比赛约一小时。

ex.en: How long does the play last?
ex.cn: 那出戏要演多长时间？

senses.def: to continue to exist or to function well
senses.chn: 继续存在；持续起作用；持久

ex.en: This weather won't last.
ex.cn: 这种天气持续不了多久。

ex.en: He's making a big effort now, and I hope it lasts.
ex.cn: 现在他正加紧努力，我希望他能坚持下去。

ex.en: These shoes should last you till next year.
ex.cn: 你这双鞋应该能穿到明年。

senses.def: to survive sth or manage to stay in the same situation, despite difficulties
senses.chn: （在困境等中）坚持下去；熬过（困境等）

ex.en: She won't last long in that job.
ex.cn: 她那份工作干不了多久。

ex.en: Can you last (out) until I can get help?
ex.cn: 你能支撑到我找来帮手吗？

ex.en: Doctors say that she probably won't last out the night (= she will probably die before the morning).
ex.cn: 医生都说她很可能活不过今晚。

ex.en: He was injured early on and didn't last the match.
ex.cn: 他开赛后不久就受了伤，没法坚持到底。

senses.def: to be enough for sb to use, especially for a particular period of time
senses.chn: 够用，足够维持（尤指某段时间）

ex.en: Will the coffee last out till next week?
ex.cn: 咖啡够喝到下周吗？

ex.en: We've got enough food to last us (for) three days.
ex.cn: 我们的食物足够维持三天。

ex.en: How long do you think this storm will last?
ex.cn: 你看这暴风雨会持续多久？

ex.en: The movie lasted over two hours.
ex.cn: 这部电影长两个多小时。

ex.en: His annoyance won't last.
ex.cn: 他的烦恼不会持续多久。

ex.en: We don't have enough money to last until next month.
ex.cn: 我们的钱不足以维持到下个月。

senses.def: a block of wood or metal shaped like a foot, used in making and repairing shoes

example.en: These shoes should last you till next year.
example.cn: 你这双鞋应该能穿到明年。

example.en: Can you last (out) until I can get help?
example.cn: 你能支撑到我找来帮手吗？

example.en: Doctors say that she probably won't last out the night (= she will probably die before the morning).
example.cn: 医生都说她很可能活不过今晚。

example.en: We've got enough food to last us (for) three days.
example.cn: 我们的食物足够维持三天。

senses.def: used when mentioning the last person or thing of a group, in order to say that they are not less important than the others
senses.chn: （提及最后的人或事物时说）最后但同样重要的

ex.en: Last but not least, I'd like to thank all the catering staff.

ex.cn: 接下来，我们来探讨一下运用幽默的性别差异问题。

senses.def: an act of passing urine from the body

ex.cn: 使用前应检查瓶子是否渗漏。

senses.def: to become known to the public

ex.cn: 计划的细节很快就泄露出去了。

ex.en: a leaky roof
ex.cn: 漏水的屋顶

senses.def: to bend or move from a vertical position

ex.cn: 我仰靠在椅背上。

ex.en: The tower is leaning dangerously.
ex.cn: 那座塔倾斜了，很危险。

ex.cn: 一个人正探身窗外。

ex.cn: 一把铁铲靠墙放着。

ex.cn: 她倚靠着她儿子的手臂缓慢行走。

senses.def: to make sth rest against sth in a sloping position

ex.en: Can I lean my bike against the wall?
ex.cn: 我能把自行车靠在这墙上吗？

senses.def: to make a great effort, especially in order to be helpful or fair

ex.en: I've bent over backwards to help him.
ex.cn: 我已尽最大努力帮助他。

senses.def: to depend on sb/sth for help and support
senses.chn: 依靠，依赖（…的帮助和支持）

ex.en: He leans heavily on his family.
ex.cn: 他在很大程度上依赖他的家庭。

senses.def: to try to influence sb by threatening them

ex.cn: 政府一直给电视公司施加压力，不准播放此节目。

senses.def: to have a tendency to prefer sth, especially a particular opinion or interest
senses.chn: 倾向，偏向（尤指某意见或利益）

ex.cn: 英国倾向于美国的提案。

senses.def: without much flesh; thin and fit

ex.en: a lean, muscular body
ex.cn: 清瘦而肌肉发达的身体

ex.en: He was tall, lean and handsome.
ex.cn: 他长得瘦高而英俊。

senses.def: containing little or no fat
difficult and not producing much money, food, etc.
senses.chn: 难以赚钱的；生产不出（食物等）的；贫乏的

ex.en: a lean period/spell
ex.cn: 不景气时期

ex.en: The company recovered well after going through several lean years.
ex.cn: 经历了几年的萧条后，这家公司的业务完全恢复了正常。

senses.def: strong and efficient because the number of employees has been reduced

ex.cn: 改革使公司更精干，更有竞争力。

senses.def: the part of meat that has little or no fat

example.en: A shovel was leaning against the wall.
example.cn: 一把铁铲靠墙放着。

example.en: She walked slowly, leaning on her son's arm.
example.cn: 她倚靠着她儿子的手臂缓慢行走。

senses.def: a tendency to prefer sth or to believe in particular ideas, opinions, etc.

ex.en: a leaning towards comedy rather than tragedy
ex.cn: 偏爱喜剧而不是悲剧

ex.en: a person with socialist leanings
ex.cn: 具有社会主义倾向的人

senses.def: a small building with its roof leaning against the side of a large building, wall or fence
senses.chn: （搭在高大建筑物、墙壁或栅栏上建的）单坡屋顶小房，披屋，披棚

ex.en: a lean-to garage
ex.cn: 单坡屋顶车库

senses.def: to jump high or a long way

ex.en: A dolphin leapt out of the water.
ex.cn: 海豚跃出水面。

ex.en: We leapt over the stream.
ex.cn: 我们跳过了那条小溪。

ex.en: The horse leapt a five-foot wall.
ex.cn: 那匹马跃过了一道五英尺高的墙。

senses.def: to move or do sth suddenly and quickly

ex.en: She leapt out of bed.
ex.cn: 她突然翻身下了床。

ex.en: He leapt across the room to answer the door.
ex.cn: 他冲过房间去应门。

ex.en: I leapt to my feet (= stood up quickly).
ex.cn: 我赶紧站了起来。

ex.en: They leapt into action immediately.
ex.cn: 他们立即断然采取了行动。

ex.en: She was quick to leap to my defence (= speak in support of me).
ex.cn: 她马上挺身而出为我辩护。

ex.en: The photo seemed to leap off the page (= it got your attention immediately).
ex.cn: 那张照片跃然纸上，引人注目。

senses.def: to increase suddenly and by a large amount

ex.cn: 股价从 476 便士猛涨到收盘时的 536 便士。

ex.cn: 我又犯老毛病了——匆忙草率地下结论。

senses.def: used to say that sb has a sudden feeling of happiness or excitement

ex.cn: 我立刻抓住了去法国的机会。

senses.def: a long or high jump

ex.cn: 一跳跳了六米

ex.cn: 她助跑后一个飞跃跳到小溪的对面。

ex.en: His heart gave a sudden leap when he saw her.
ex.cn: 他看见她时，心猛地一跳。

ex.en: Few people successfully make the leap from television to the movies.
ex.cn: 从电视业转向电影业很少有人成功。

senses.def: a sudden large change or increase in sth

ex.cn: 利润跃升

senses.def: very quickly; in large amounts
senses.chn: 非常迅速；飞跃地；突飞猛进；大量地

ex.en: Her health has improved in leaps and bounds.
ex.cn: 她的健康已迅速好转。

senses.def: an action or a risk that you take without knowing anything about the activity or what the result will be

example.en: A dolphin leapt out of the water.
example.cn: 海豚跃出水面。

example.en: The horse leapt a five-foot wall.
example.cn: 那匹马跃过了一道五英尺高的墙。

senses.def: to accept a chance or an opportunity quickly and with enthusiasm
senses.chn: 赶紧抓住，急不可待地接受（机会）

ex.cn: 我立刻抓住了去法国的机会。

senses.def: a children's game in which players take turns to jump over the backs of other players who are bending down
senses.chn: 跳背游戏（游戏者轮流从其他弯背站立者身上跳过）

senses.def: to get to a higher position or rank by going past sb else or by missing out some stages

ex.cn: 这场胜利使他们连超三个队，跃居第二位。

ex.cn: 学一种语言／乐器／技能

ex.cn: 我从父亲那里学到了许多东西。

ex.cn: 你只要注意看其他运动员怎么做就能学到许多东西。

ex.cn: 她热衷于学习日本文化。

ex.cn: 这本书是有关小孩怎样学习的。

ex.cn: 他在学跳舞。

ex.cn: 我从一位好友那里听说她到了。

ex.cn: 他们听到这个消息有什么反应？

ex.cn: 我们明天上学得背诵一段哈姆雷特的台词。

ex.en: All dogs must be kept on a leash in public places.
ex.cn: 在公共场所所有的狗必须用皮带牵住。

ex.en: Like all youngsters, he's straining at the leash to leave home.
ex.cn: 跟所有年轻人一样，他也急于离开家生活。

senses.def: to control an animal, especially a dog, with a lead1 (6) / leash
senses.chn: 用皮带系住，拴住，缚住（尤指狗）

senses.def: smallest in size, amount, degree, etc.
senses.chn: 最小的；最少的；程度最轻的

ex.en: He's the best teacher, even though he has the least experience.
ex.cn: 他虽然经验最少，却是最出色的老师。

ex.en: She never had the least idea what to do about it.
ex.cn: 这事怎么办，她一点主意都没有。

ex.en: He gave (the) least of all towards the wedding present.
ex.cn: 买结婚礼物，他出的钱最少。

ex.en: How others see me is the least of my worries (= I have more important things to worry about).
ex.cn: 别人怎么看我，我一点都不在乎。

ex.en: It's the least I can do to help (= I feel I should do more).
ex.cn: 这是我所能帮忙做的最起码的事。

senses.def: used after amounts to show that the amount is the lowest possible

ex.en: It'll take a year, at the very least.
ex.cn: 这至少需要一年时间。

senses.def: not at all

ex.en: Really, I'm not in the least tired.
ex.cn: 说真的，我一点也不累。

ex.en: 'Do you mind if I put the television on?' 'No, not in the least.'
ex.cn: “我开电视机你介意吗？” “不，一点也不介意。”

senses.def: without exaggerating at all

ex.en: I was surprised, to say the least.
ex.cn: 毫不夸张地说，我感到吃惊。

senses.def: to the smallest degree

ex.en: He always turns up just when you least expect him.
ex.cn: 他总是在你最意料不到的时候出现。

ex.en: She chose the least expensive of the hotels.
ex.cn: 她挑了一家最便宜的旅馆。

ex.en: I never hid the truth, least of all from you.
ex.cn: 我从不隐瞒事实，尤其是对你。

senses.def: not less than

ex.en: It'll cost at least 500 dollars.
ex.cn: 这东西至少要花 500 美元。

ex.en: She must be at least 40.
ex.cn: 她至少应该有 40 岁了。

ex.en: Cut the grass at least once a week in summer.
ex.cn: 夏天至少每周割一次草。

ex.en: I've known her at least as long as you have.
ex.cn: 我认识她至少和你认识她的时间一样久了。

senses.chn: （用于对否定情况补充肯定的评论）起码

ex.en: She may be slow but at least she's reliable.
ex.cn: 她虽然迟钝，但起码还很可靠。

senses.def: even if nothing else is true or you do nothing else

ex.en: You could at least listen to what he says.
ex.cn: 你至少可以听一听他说些什么。

ex.en: Well, at least they weren't bored.
ex.cn: 唔，反正他们没有厌烦。

senses.def: used to limit or make what you have just said less definite
senses.chn: （用以减轻前面所说的话的肯定性）至少

ex.en: They seldom complained—officially at least.
ex.cn: 他们很少抱怨，至少不在正式场合这样做。

ex.en: It works, at least I think it does.
ex.cn: 它行，反正我认为它行。

senses.def: especially

ex.en: The documentary caused a lot of bad feeling, not least among the workers whose lives it described.
ex.cn: 那部纪录片引起了许多人的反感，片中描写到其生活的工人尤其如此。

senses.def: used when mentioning the last person or thing of a group, in order to say that they are not less important than the others
senses.chn: （提及最后的人或事物时说）最后但同样重要的

ex.en: Last but not least, I'd like to thank all the catering staff.
ex.cn: 最后但同样重要的是，我要感谢所有的餐饮工作人员。

a bad situation will pass or be forgotten most quickly if nothing more is said about it
senses.chn: 只要没人再说，事情就会过去

ex.cn: 去那里费用可不低，至少在一年中的这个时节是这样。

ex.cn: 皮夹克

ex.cn: 鞋底是皮革做的。

ex.cn: 皮面装帧的书

ex.cn: 拼命快骑

ex.cn: 寿命长；寿命短

ex.en: He became very weak towards the end of his life.
ex.cn: 他临终时很虚弱。

ex.en: Brenda took up tennis late in life.
ex.cn: 布伦达在晚年打起网球来了。

ex.en: He will spend the rest of his life (= until he dies) in a wheelchair.
ex.cn: 他将在轮椅上度过他的余生。

senses.def: a period of sb's life when they are in a particular situation or job
senses.chn: （某情景或工作的）一段生活经历

ex.en: She has been an accountant all her working life.
ex.cn: 她在整个职业生涯中一直是会计师。

ex.en: He met a lot of interesting people during his life as a student.
ex.cn: 他在学生时代接触过许多有趣的人。

ex.en: They were very happy throughout their married life.
ex.cn: 他们婚后生活一直很幸福。

senses.def: the period of time when sth exists or functions
senses.chn: 存在期；（某物的）寿命；有效期

ex.en: The International Stock Exchange started life as a London coffee shop.
ex.cn: 国际证券交易所起初就是伦敦的一家咖啡馆。

ex.en: They could see that the company had a limited life (= it was going to close).
ex.cn: 他们意识到公司的寿命不长了。

ex.en: In Italy the average life of a government is eleven months.
ex.cn: 意大利每届政府的平均寿命是十一个月。

senses.def: the punishment of being sent to prison for life; life imprisonment

ex.en: The judge gave him life.
ex.cn: 法官判他无期徒刑。

senses.def: the experience and activities that are typical of all people's existences

ex.en: the worries of everyday life
ex.cn: 日常生活中的操心事

ex.en: He is young and has little experience of life.
ex.cn: 他年轻，不谙世事。

ex.en: Commuting is a part of daily life for many people.
ex.cn: 乘车上下班是许多人日常生活的一部分。

ex.en: Jill wants to travel and see life for herself.
ex.cn: 吉尔想出去旅行，亲身体验一下生活。

ex.en: We bought a dishwasher to make life easier.
ex.cn: 为使生活轻松些我们买了一台洗碗机。

ex.en: In London life can be hard.
ex.cn: 在伦敦生活会很艰苦。

senses.def: the activities and experiences that are typical of a particular way of living

ex.en: country/city life
ex.cn: 乡村／城市生活

ex.en: She enjoyed political life.
ex.cn: 她喜欢政治生活。

ex.en: family/married life
ex.cn: 家庭／婚姻生活

ex.en: How do you find life in Japan?
ex.cn: 你觉得日本的生活如何？

senses.def: a person's experiences during their life; the activities that form a particular part of a person's life
senses.chn: 个人生活；个人经历；个人生活某一方面的活动

ex.en: He has had a good life.
ex.cn: 他一直过着优裕的生活。

ex.en: a hard/an easy life
ex.cn: 艰难／安逸舒适的生活

ex.en: My day-to-day life is not very exciting.
ex.cn: 我的日常生活很平淡。

ex.en: a life of luxury
ex.cn: 奢侈的生活

ex.en: Her daily life involved meeting lots of people.
ex.cn: 她在日常生活中要接触很多人。

ex.en: Many of these children have led very sheltered lives (= they have not had many different experiences).
ex.cn: 这些儿童中很多人都是温室里的花朵。

senses.def: the quality of being active and exciting

ex.en: This is a great holiday resort that is full of life.
ex.cn: 这里生气勃勃，是一个绝妙的度假胜地。

senses.def: a living model or a real object or scene that people draw or paint

ex.en: She had lessons in drawing from life.
ex.cn: 她学了实物写生课程。

ex.en: a life class (= one in which art students draw a naked man or woman)
ex.cn: 人体写生课

senses.def: a story of sb's life

ex.en: She wrote a life of Mozart.
ex.cn: 她写了一部莫扎特的传记。

senses.def: one of a set number of chances before a player is out of a game
senses.chn: （玩游戏者出局前几次机会中的）一次机会

ex.en: He's lost two lives, so he's only got one left.
ex.cn: 他失去了两次机会，所以只剩下一次了。

senses.def: be the most important person or thing to sb
senses.chn: 对某人至关重要的人（或事物）

ex.en: My children are my life.
ex.cn: 我这几个孩子就是我的命根子。

ex.en: Writing is his life.
ex.cn: 写作是他的生命。

senses.def: to make sb/sth more interesting or exciting

ex.en: The new teacher really brought French to life for us.
ex.cn: 新来的老师给我们把法语教得生动活泼。

ex.en: Flowers can bring a dull room back to life.
ex.cn: 鲜花可使沉闷的房间恢复生气。

senses.def: to become more interesting, exciting or full of activity
senses.chn: 变得更有趣（或使人兴奋）；变得活跃

ex.en: The match finally came to life in the second half.
ex.cn: 比赛在下半场终于精彩起来。

senses.def: to start to act or move as if alive

ex.en: In my dream all my toys came to life.
ex.cn: 在我的梦里，玩具都活过来了。

senses.def: as hard or as fast as possible

ex.en: She was holding on to the rope for dear life.
ex.cn: 她死命抓着那根绳子。

ex.en: Run for your life!
ex.cn: 快跑啊！

senses.def: however hard you try

ex.en: I cannot for the life of me imagine why they want to leave.
ex.cn: 我怎么也想象不出他们为什么要走。

senses.def: to frighten sb very much
senses.chn: 把某人吓得魂不附体；使魂飞魄散

senses.def: having a lot of energy
senses.chn: 充满活力；精力充沛；生气勃勃

senses.def: used to tell sb to stop being boring and to do sth more interesting
senses.chn: （让人别再令人厌烦，要做更有趣的事）来点儿有意思的

senses.def: to die in order to save sb/sth
to live an enjoyable and comfortable life with no problems or responsibilities
senses.chn: 无忧无虑地生活；安逸地生活；舒适愉快地生活

senses.def: the possibility or belief that people continue to exist in some form after they die
the most amusing and interesting person at a party, etc.
senses.chn: （聚会等场合）最活跃风趣的人

senses.def: used to say that there is a situation in which it is not thought to be important if people somewhere die or are treated badly
senses.chn: 把他人生死视同儿戏；视人性命如草芥；人命不值钱

senses.def: seeming to move or function by itself without a person touching or working it
used to say that it is not worth wasting time doing sth that you dislike or that is not important
senses.chn: 人生苦短；不可枉费此生

senses.def: to cause problems for sb
senses.chn: （给某人）惹麻烦，造成困难，出难题

senses.def: the man or woman that you are having a sexual or romantic relationship with
senses.chn: 闯进你生活中的男人（或女人）

senses.def: used to refuse very firmly to do sth
to kill sb
senses.chn: 杀死（某人）；取某人的性命

senses.def: to kill yourself
to risk being killed
senses.chn: 冒生命危险；豁出性命；把脑袋别在裤腰带上

ex.en: You take your life in your hands just crossing the road here.
ex.cn: 你在这里过马路简直是冒险玩命。

senses.def: used when you are disappointed about sth but know that you must accept it
senses.chn: （表示失望但无可奈何）这就是生活，生活就是这样

senses.def: in a bad situation you must not give up hope because there is always a chance that it will improve
senses.chn: 活着（就有希望）；留得青山在（，不怕没柴烧）

senses.def: used to say that you are certain that sth will happen

ex.en: You can bet your bottom dollar that he'll be late.
ex.cn: 他肯定会迟到。

senses.def: an essential part of a person's existence
to improve sth by introducing new ideas and making people more interested in it
senses.chn: （给某事物）带来起色，注入活力

senses.def: to die. People say 'depart this life' to avoid saying 'die'.
senses.chn: 离开人世，去世，亡故（委婉说法，与 die 同义）

senses.def: an unhappy life, full of problems or unfair treatment
senses.chn: 悲惨的生活；牛马不如的生活

senses.def: to spend the last part of your life in a particular state or place
senses.chn: （在某种状态下或某处）度过余生，安度晚年

ex.en: He ended his days in poverty.
ex.cn: 他在贫穷中度过余生。

senses.def: a situation that cannot be changed, especially one that is unpleasant
the details about sex and about how babies are born, especially as told to children
feeling frightened that you might be killed
senses.chn: 害怕会丧生；为生命安全担忧

senses.def: to make a great effort to stay alive, especially when you are badly injured or seriously ill
senses.chn: （尤指严重伤病时）与死亡作斗争

senses.def: a method of helping sb who has stopped breathing to breathe again by placing your mouth on theirs and forcing air into their lungs
used to show surprise at seeing sb/sth

ex.en: I hadn't seen her for fifteen years and then there she was, (as) large as life.
ex.cn: 我有十五年未见过她，却在那里遇见她了，没错，就是她。

senses.def: looking or behaving in a way that is more interesting or exciting than other people, and so is likely to attract attention

ex.en: He's a larger than life character.
ex.cn: 他这个人不是一般的有趣，很招眼。

senses.def: the chance to live or last longer, or with a better quality of life
senses.chn: 延年益寿；生活质量更好

ex.en: Since her hip operation she's had a new lease of life.
ex.cn: 她自髋关节手术以后活得更有劲了。

senses.def: the person sb loves more than any other
used to describe a situation that is very important or serious
senses.chn: 生死攸关的事；成败的关键

senses.def: to behave in a way that makes sb else feel very unhappy
to be very lucky in dangerous situations
to risk being killed or injured in order to do sth
to be completely unable to do sth
senses.chn: 完全干不了某事；死也做不了某事

ex.en: He can't interview people to save his life.
ex.cn: 要他的命，他也采访不了人。

senses.def: a film/movie, play or book that gives a very realistic view of ordinary life
senses.chn: 反映现实生活的电影（或戏剧、书）

senses.def: to suddenly start working or doing sth

ex.en: 'Let's go!' he said, springing into action.
ex.cn: 他突然行动起来，说道：“咱们走！”

ex.en: The town springs into life (= becomes busy) during the carnival.
ex.cn: 狂欢节期间，全城突然热闹起来。

senses.def: a basic food, especially bread
when you say that's the story of my life about an unfortunate experience you have had, you mean you have had many similar experiences
senses.chn: 我就是这个命（表示一生中有很多类似的不幸经历）

senses.def: at the age you are (especially when you are not young)
senses.chn: 在…这样的年纪（尤指不年轻时）

ex.en: Eyesight doesn't get any better at my time of life.
ex.cn: 到我这把年纪，视力绝不会变好的。

senses.def: to enjoy yourself very much
seeming real rather than invented
senses.chn: 真实的；逼真的；惟妙惟肖；活灵活现

senses.def: new and exciting experiences make life more interesting
senses.chn: 经历丰富多彩才令生活充满乐趣

senses.def: a person's job or position in society

ex.en: She has friends from all walks of life.
ex.cn: 她在社会各界中都有朋友。

senses.def: the typical pattern of behaviour of a person or group
senses.chn: （个人或群体的）特有的行为模式，典型生活方式

ex.en: the American way of life
ex.cn: 美国人的生活方式

senses.def: the possibility or belief that people continue to exist in some form after they die
extremely serious, especially when there is a situation in which people might die
senses.chn: 生死攸关的；关系重大的

ex.en: a life-and-death decision/struggle
ex.cn: 生死攸关的决定；生死存亡的斗争

senses.def: a large ring made of material that floats well, that is used to rescue sb who has fallen into water, to prevent them from drowning
a special belt worn to help sb float in water
the thing that keeps sth strong and healthy and is necessary for successful development

ex.en: Tourism is the lifeblood of the city.
ex.cn: 旅游业是这座城市的命脉。

senses.def: a person's blood, when it is thought of as the thing that is necessary for life
a special boat that is sent out to rescue people who are in danger at sea
senses.chn: （派往海上救助的）救生艇，救生船

ex.en: a lifeboat crew/station
ex.cn: 救生船全体船员／停泊港

senses.def: a small boat carried on a ship in order to save the people on board if the ship sinks
a piece of material that floats well, used to rescue sb who has fallen into water, by keeping them above water
a person who is employed by sb to give them advice about how to achieve the things they want in their life and work
senses.chn: 人生教练，生涯顾问（受雇帮助他人实现人生和工作目标）

senses.def: the series of forms into which a living thing changes as it develops
senses.chn: 生命周期，生活周期（生物发展过程的系列变形）

ex.en: the life cycle of the butterfly
ex.cn: 蝴蝶的生命周期

senses.def: the period of time during which sth, for example a product, is developed and used
senses.chn: 生命周期，寿命（产品等从开发到使用完毕的一段时间）

senses.def: making you feel happier and making life more enjoyable
the number of years that a person is likely to live; the length of time that sth is likely to exist or continue for
senses.chn: 预期寿命；预计存在（或持续）的期限

senses.def: the force that gives sb/sth their strength or energy

ex.en: He looked very ill—his life force seemed to have drained away.
ex.cn: 他看上去病得很厉害，他的生命力似乎枯竭了。

senses.def: the force that keeps all life in existence

ex.en: In Hindi philosophy the life force is known as prana.
ex.cn: 在印度哲学中生命气息称为 prana（息）。

senses.def: a living thing such as a plant or an animal
that gives life or keeps sth alive
senses.chn: 赋予生命的；维持生命的

senses.def: a person who is employed at a beach or a swimming pool to rescue people who are in danger in the water
all the events that happen in the life of a person, an animal or a plant
a type of insurance in which you make regular payments so that you receive a sum of money when you are a particular age, or so that your family will receive a sum of money when you die

ex.en: a life insurance policy
ex.cn: 人寿保险单

senses.def: used to say that there is a situation in which it is not thought to be important if people somewhere die or are treated badly
senses.chn: 把他人生死视同儿戏；视人性命如草芥；人命不值钱

senses.def: a jacket without sleeves, that can be filled with air, designed to help you float if you fall in water
dead or appearing to be dead
not living; not having living things growing on or in it
senses.chn: 无生命的；无生物生长的

ex.en: lifeless machines
ex.cn: 无生命的机器

ex.en: a lifeless planet
ex.cn: 没有生命存在的行星

senses.def: dull; lacking the qualities that make sth/sb interesting and full of life
senses.chn: 枯燥的；单调的；缺乏生气的

ex.en: his lifeless performance on stage
ex.cn: 他在舞台上死气沉沉的表演

senses.def: exactly like a real person or thing
senses.chn: 逼真的；生动的；栩栩如生的

ex.en: a lifelike statue/drawing/toy
ex.cn: 栩栩如生的雕塑／绘画；逼真的玩具

senses.def: a line or rope thrown to rescue sb who is in difficulty in the water
a line attached to sb who goes deep under the sea
something that is very important for sb and that they depend on

ex.en: The extra payments are a lifeline for most single mothers.
ex.cn: 额外补助对大多数单身母亲来说都是赖以生存的生命线。

senses.def: lasting or existing all through your life
(in Britain) a person who is given the title of peer (= 'Lord' or 'Lady') but who cannot pass it on to their son or daughter
senses.chn: （英国爵位不能世袭的）终身贵族

senses.def: a piece of material that floats well, or a jacket made of such material, used to rescue a person who has fallen into water, by keeping them above water
a person who has been sent to prison for their whole life
an open rubber boat filled with air, used for rescuing people from sinking ships or planes
senses.chn: 充气救生船；橡皮救生筏

senses.def: a thing that helps sb in a difficult situation; sth that saves sb's life

ex.en: The new drug is a potential lifesaver.
ex.cn: 这种新药有可能成为一种救命药。

senses.def: that is going to save sb's life

ex.en: a life-saving heart operation
ex.cn: 挽救生命的心脏手术

senses.def: the skills needed to save sb who is in water and is drowning

ex.en: a life-saving qualification
ex.cn: 救生资格

senses.def: the sciences concerned with studying humans, animals or plants
the punishment by which sb spends the rest of their life in prison
the same size as a person or thing really is
senses.chn: 与真人（或实物）一样大小的

ex.en: a life-size statue
ex.cn: 与真人一样大的雕像

senses.def: the length of time that sth is likely to live, continue or function
senses.chn: 寿命；可持续年限；有效期

ex.en: Worms have a lifespan of a few months.
ex.cn: 蠕虫的寿命为几个月。

senses.def: used to say that it is not worth wasting time doing sth that you dislike or that is not important
senses.chn: 人生苦短；不可枉费此生

senses.def: the story that sb tells you about their whole life
the way in which a person or a group of people lives and works

ex.en: a comfortable/healthy/lavish, etc. lifestyle
ex.cn: 舒适、健康、挥霍无度等的生活方式

ex.en: It was a big change in lifestyle when we moved to the country.
ex.cn: 我们迁居到乡下，这在生活方式上是个巨大的变化。

ex.en: the lifestyle section of the newspaper (= the part which deals with clothes, furniture, hobbies, etc.)
ex.cn: 报纸的生活栏目

senses.def: the fact of sb being on a life-support machine

ex.en: Families want the right to refuse life support.
ex.cn: 病人亲属要求有权拒绝使用机器维持生命。

ex.en: She's critically ill, on life support.
ex.cn: 她病情危急，靠机器来维持生命。

senses.def: a piece of equipment that keeps sb alive when they are extremely ill/sick and cannot breathe without help
senses.chn: 生命维持设备；用以维持生命的机器

ex.en: He was put on a life-support machine in intensive care.
ex.cn: 在特护期间给他使用了生命维持设备。

senses.def: the main purpose or activity in a person's life, or their greatest achievement
senses.chn: 毕生的主要目的（或活动）；终生最大的成就

senses.def: that is likely to kill sb
senses.chn: 可能致命的；威胁着生命的

ex.en: His heart condition is not life-threatening.
ex.cn: 他的心脏病不会危及生命。

senses.def: the length of time that sb lives or that sth lasts
senses.chn: 一生；终身；有生之年；（某物的）存在期，寿命，使用期限

ex.en: His diary was not published during his lifetime.
ex.cn: 他的日记在他生前未曾发表过。

ex.en: a lifetime of experience
ex.cn: 毕生的经验

ex.en: in the lifetime of the present government
ex.cn: 在本届政府的任期内

senses.def: a wonderful opportunity, etc. that you are not likely to get again
senses.chn: 终身难得的机遇；千载难逢的机会

senses.def: used to describe sth special that is not likely to happen to you again

ex.en: An opportunity like this comes once in a lifetime.
ex.cn: 像这样的机会一生也许只会遇到一次。

ex.en: a once-in-a-lifetime experience
ex.cn: 一生只会拥有一次的经历

senses.def: to raise sb/sth or be raised to a higher position or level

ex.en: He stood there with his arms lifted above his head.
ex.cn: 他站在那里，胳臂举过了头顶。

ex.en: I lifted the lid of the box and peered in.
ex.cn: 我掀起箱盖往里看。

ex.en: John lifted his eyes (= looked up) from his book.
ex.cn: 约翰从书本上抬起眼睛。

ex.en: Her eyebrows lifted. 'Apologize? Why?'
ex.cn: 她的眉毛竖了起来：“道歉？为什么？”

senses.def: to take hold of sb/sth and move them/it to a different position

ex.en: I lifted the baby out of the chair.
ex.cn: 我把婴儿从椅子上抱起来。

ex.en: He lifted the suitcase down from the rack.
ex.cn: 他把手提箱从行李架上搬下来。

senses.def: to transport people or things by air

ex.en: The survivors were lifted to safety by helicopter.
ex.cn: 幸存者由直升机运往安全的地方。

senses.def: to remove or end restrictions

ex.en: to lift a ban/curfew/blockade
ex.cn: 解除禁令／宵禁／封锁

ex.en: Martial law has now been lifted.
ex.cn: 戒严令现已解除。

senses.def: to become or make sb more cheerful

ex.en: His heart lifted at the sight of her.
ex.cn: 他一看见她心里就高兴起来了。

ex.en: The news lifted our spirits.
ex.cn: 这消息使我们群情振奋。

senses.def: to rise and disappear

ex.en: The fog began to lift.
ex.cn: 雾开始散了。

ex.en: Gradually my depression started to lift.
ex.cn: 我的沮丧情绪开始逐渐消失。

senses.def: to steal sth

ex.en: He had been lifting electrical goods from the store where he worked.
ex.cn: 他一直从他工作的商店里偷窃电器商品。

senses.def: to use sb's ideas or words without asking permission or without saying where they come from

ex.en: She lifted most of the ideas from a book she had been reading.
ex.cn: 大部分观点都是她从一直在看的一本书里抄来的。

senses.def: to dig up vegetables or plants from the ground
senses.chn: 挖出，刨出，拔起（蔬菜或植物）

ex.en: to lift potatoes
ex.cn: 刨土豆

senses.def: to make the amount or level of sth greater; to become greater in amount or level

ex.en: Interest rates were lifted yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天利率提高了。

senses.def: to do nothing to help sb
senses.chn: 一点忙也不帮；油瓶倒了都不扶

ex.en: The children never lift a finger to help around the house.
ex.cn: 孩子们从不帮着做家务。

senses.def: a similar piece of equipment that is used for reading barcodes
the existence of too much artificial light in the environment, for example from street lights, which makes it difficult to see the stars
a small ship that stays at a particular place at sea and that has a powerful light on it to warn and guide other ships
a display of changing coloured lights, for example at a pop concert
senses.chn: （流行音乐会等的）灯光变幻表演

senses.def: to begin to smoke a cigarette

ex.en: They all lit up as soon as he left the room.
ex.cn: 他一离开房间他们就都抽起烟来。

ex.en: He sat back and lit up a cigarette.
ex.cn: 他往椅背上一靠，点上烟吸了起来。

senses.def: to become or to make sth become bright with light or colour

ex.en: There was an explosion and the whole sky lit up.
ex.cn: 一声爆炸照亮了整个天空。

senses.def: if sb's eyes or face light up, or sth lights them up, they show happiness or excitement

ex.en: His eyes lit up when she walked into the room.
ex.cn: 看见她走进房间，他两眼一亮。

ex.en: A smile lit up her face.
ex.cn: 她微微一笑，脸上露出了喜色。

senses.def: water that contains the normal amount of deuterium
senses.chn: 轻水（即普通水，水中氘含量不超过正常值）

senses.def: a type of foam (= mass of bubbles) used to put out fires
made of thinner material and less heavy than usual

ex.en: a lightweight jacket
ex.cn: 轻便的短上衣

senses.def: not very serious or impressive
senses.chn: 不严肃的；给人印象不深的

ex.en: a lightweight book
ex.cn: 内容平庸的书

ex.en: He was considered too lightweight for the job.
ex.cn: 有人认为他资历太浅，不适合做这工作。

senses.def: a boxer weighing between 57 and 61 kilograms, heavier than a featherweight
senses.chn: 轻量级拳击手（体重在 57 至 61 公斤之间）

ex.en: a lightweight champion
ex.cn: 轻量级拳击冠军

senses.def: a person or thing that weighs less than is usual
senses.chn: 体重低于通常重量的人；比通常重量轻的东西

senses.def: a person or thing of little importance or influence
senses.chn: 无足轻重的人（或事）；没有影响力的人（或事）

ex.en: a political lightweight
ex.cn: 政治上的无名之辈

ex.en: He's an intellectual lightweight (= he does not think very deeply or seriously).
ex.cn: 他是个智力平庸的人。

senses.def: the distance that light travels in one year, 9.4607 × 1012 kilometres
senses.chn: 光年（指光在一年中走过的距离，为 9.4607 × 1012 公里）

ex.en: The nearest star to earth is about 4 light years away.
ex.cn: 地球离最近的恒星大约为 4 光年。

senses.def: a very long time

ex.en: Full employment still seems light years away.
ex.cn: 充分就业好像依然遥遥无期。

senses.def: a soft brown type of coal
similar to sb/sth

ex.en: She's wearing a dress like mine.
ex.cn: 她穿的连衣裙和我的相似。

ex.en: He's very like his father.
ex.cn: 他很像他的父亲。

ex.en: She looks nothing like (= not at all like) her mother.
ex.cn: 她长得一点也不像她母亲。

ex.en: That sounds like (= I think I can hear) him coming now.
ex.cn: 听声音像是他来了。

senses.def: used to ask sb's opinion of sb/sth

ex.en: What's it like studying in Spain?
ex.cn: 在西班牙念书怎么样？

ex.en: This new girlfriend of his—what's she like?
ex.cn: 他这个新的女朋友是个什么样的人？

senses.def: used to show what is usual or typical for sb
senses.chn: （指某人常做的事）符合…的特点，像…才会

ex.en: It's just like her to tell everyone about it.
ex.cn: 她就是那样，会把这事见谁就告诉谁。

senses.def: in the same way as sb/sth

ex.en: Students were angry at being treated like children.
ex.cn: 学生对于把他们当小孩子对待感到气愤。

ex.en: He ran like the wind (= very fast).
ex.cn: 他跑得飞快。

ex.en: You do it like this.
ex.cn: 你照这样做。

ex.en: I, like everyone else, had read these stories in the press.
ex.cn: 我像大家一样，也已经从报纸上看过这些报道。

ex.en: Don't look at me like that.
ex.cn: 别那样看着我。

ex.en: The candles are arranged like so (= in this way).
ex.cn: 蜡烛都是像这样排列的。

senses.def: for example

ex.en: anti-utopian novels like 'Animal Farm' and '1984'
ex.cn: 诸如《动物庄园》和《1984》之类的反乌托邦小说

ex.en: He has blue eyes like me.
ex.cn: 他和我一样有双蓝眼睛。

ex.en: She enjoys all kinds of music, as I do.
ex.cn: 她和我一样什么音乐都喜欢。

ex.en: Repeat these five steps, as in the last exercise.
ex.cn: 照前面的练习一样，重复这五个步骤。

ex.en: Nobody understands him like I do.
ex.cn: 谁都不像我那么了解他。

ex.en: I don't want to upset him again like before.
ex.cn: 我不愿意再像过去那样使他扫兴。

senses.def: used to give a number or an amount that is more accurate than one previously mentioned
senses.chn: （提供比以前更准确的数量）差不多，更接近

ex.en: He believes the figure should be more like $10 million.
ex.cn: 他认为数额若是 1 000 万美元就差不多了。

senses.def: better; more acceptable
senses.chn: 比较好；还差不多；才像话

ex.en: This is more like it! Real food—not that canned muck.
ex.cn: 这才像样嘛！是真正的食物，而不是那种罐装的垃圾食品。

senses.def: used to give what you think is a better description of sth
senses.chn: （更恰当地描述）倒更像是，说…还差不多

ex.en: Just talking? Arguing more like it.
ex.cn: 仅仅是谈论？说是争论还差不多。

senses.def: used to say that sb has done sth annoying, silly, etc.
senses.chn: （表示某人做了令人讨厌、愚蠢之类的事）某人怎么回事，某人怎么会是这个样子

ex.en: Oh, what am I like? I just completely forgot it.
ex.cn: 啊，我这是怎么啦？我竟把这事忘得一干二净了。

senses.def: to find sb/sth pleasant, attractive or of a good enough standard; to enjoy sth

ex.en: She's nice. I like her.
ex.cn: 她人很好，我喜欢她。

ex.en: Do you like their new house?
ex.cn: 你喜欢他们的新房子吗？

ex.en: Which tie do you like best?
ex.cn: 你最喜欢哪条领带？

ex.en: How did you like Japan (= did you find it pleasant)?
ex.cn: 你觉得日本怎么样？

ex.en: I don't like the way he's looking at me.
ex.cn: 我讨厌他看着我的样子。

ex.en: You've got to go to school, whether you like it or not.
ex.cn: 不管你喜欢不喜欢，你得上学。

senses.def: to prefer to do sth; to prefer sth to be made or to happen in a particular way
senses.chn: 喜欢做；喜欢（以某种方式制作或产生的东西）

ex.en: At weekends I like to sleep late.
ex.cn: 周末我爱睡懒觉。

ex.en: I like my coffee strong.
ex.cn: 咖啡我爱喝浓的。

senses.def: to want

ex.en: Do what you like—I don't care.
ex.cn: 你想做什么就做什么，我不在乎。

ex.en: You can dye your hair whatever colour you like.
ex.cn: 你的头发你想怎么染就怎么染。

senses.def: used in negative sentences to mean 'to be unwilling to do sth'

ex.en: I didn't like to disturb you.
ex.cn: 我本不愿打搅你。

ex.en: He doesn't like asking his parents for help.
ex.cn: 他不愿向父母求助。

senses.def: used with would or should as a polite way to say what you want or to ask what sb wants
senses.chn: （与 would 或 should 连用表示客气）想，想要，希望

ex.en: Would you like a drink?
ex.cn: 你想喝一杯吗？

ex.en: I'd like to think it over.
ex.cn: 我想考虑一下这个问题。

ex.en: Would you like to come with us?
ex.cn: 你想不想和我们一块儿去？

ex.en: We would like to apologize for the delay.
ex.cn: 我们对延迟表示歉意。

ex.en: How can they afford it? That's what I'd like to know.
ex.cn: 他们怎么买得起这东西？这倒是我所想知道的。

ex.en: We'd like you to come and visit us.
ex.cn: 我们想请你来我们这儿做客。

senses.def: if you like sth on a social networking service, news website, blog , etc. you show that you agree with it or that you think it is good by clicking a special button
senses.chn: （在社交网络、新闻网站、博客等上）给…点赞

ex.en: By the next morning, over twenty of my friends had liked my new profile picture.
ex.cn: 到第二天早上，我的二十多个朋友对我的新用户头像点了赞。

senses.def: used to emphasize that sth bad has happened to you and you want some sympathy
senses.chn: （强调遭遇不佳并想得到同情）你会感觉怎么样呢

ex.en: How would you like it if someone called you a liar?
ex.cn: 如果有人说你撒谎，你会怎么想呢？

senses.def: used to politely agree to sth or to suggest sth
senses.chn: （礼貌地同意或建议）如果你要这样做，你要是愿意的话

ex.en: 'Shall we stop now?' 'If you like.'
ex.cn: “我们现在停下来好吗？” “听你的。”

ex.en: If you like, we could go out this evening.
ex.cn: 你如果愿意的话，咱们今晚可以出去。

senses.def: used when you express sth in a new way or when you are not confident about sth
senses.chn: （用新方式表达或不确定时说）换句话说，可以说

ex.en: It was, if you like, the dawn of a new era.
ex.cn: 换句话说，那就是新时代的黎明。

senses.def: used to protest that sth that has been said is not true or fair
senses.chn: （抗议所言不实或不公）亏你说得出口

ex.en: 'She called you a cheat.' 'Well, I like that!'
ex.cn: “她说你是骗子。” “哦，说得好哇！”

senses.def: used to say that you hope or believe that sth is true
senses.chn: （表示希望或相信某事属实）我倒想…

ex.en: I like to think I'm broad-minded.
ex.cn: 我倒想心胸开阔。

senses.def: used to say that sth is very good or enjoyable
senses.chn: （用以表示非常好或令人愉快）

ex.en: You get paid to eat chocolate. So what's not to like?
ex.cn: 你吃巧克力还能得到报酬，这不很好吗？

senses.def: in the same way as

ex.en: No one sings the blues like she did.
ex.cn: 没人像她那样唱蓝调歌曲。

ex.en: It didn't turn out like I intended.
ex.cn: 这结果与我的本意相悖。

ex.en: Like I said (= as I said before), you're always welcome to stay.
ex.cn: 正如我以前所说的一样，我永远都欢迎你留下来。

senses.def: as if

ex.en: She acts like she owns the place.
ex.cn: 她的举动就像那地方是她的一样。

senses.def: the things that you like

ex.en: We all have different likes and dislikes.
ex.cn: 我们各有不同的好恶。

senses.def: a person or thing that is similar to another

ex.en: jazz, rock and the like (= similar types of music)
ex.cn: 爵士乐、摇滚乐以及诸如此类的音乐

ex.en: a man whose like we shall not see again
ex.cn: 我们再也不会见到的那种男人

ex.en: You're not comparing like with like.
ex.cn: 你比较的不是同类的东西。

senses.def: used to refer to sb/sth that is considered as a type, especially one that is considered as good as sb/sth else
senses.chn: （尤指被视为和某人或某事物一样好的）种类，类型

ex.en: She didn't want to associate with the likes of me.
ex.cn: 她不想与我这种类型的人交往。

senses.def: if something on a social networking service, news website, blog , etc. receives a like, it means that somebody has shown that they agree with it or think it is good by clicking a special button
senses.chn: （对社交网络、新闻网站、博客等的内容的）点赞

ex.en: The band now has thousands of likes.
ex.cn: 该乐队现在得到了成千上万个点赞。

senses.def: having similar qualities to another person or thing

ex.en: a chance to meet people of like mind (= with similar interests and opinions)
ex.cn: 结识志趣相投的人的机会

ex.en: She responded in like manner.
ex.cn: 她以类似的方式作出了反应。

senses.def: used in very informal speech, for example when you are thinking what to say next, explaining sth, or giving an example of sth
senses.chn: （非正式口语，思考该说什么、解释或举例时用）

ex.en: It was, like, weird.
ex.cn: 这事儿，就是说，有点怪。

ex.en: It was kind of scary, like.
ex.cn: 这还挺可怕的。

ex.en: It's really hard. Like I have no time for my own work.
ex.cn: 这事真费劲，弄得我没时间做自己的工作了。

senses.def: used in very informal speech to show that what you are saying may not be exactly right but is nearly so

ex.en: I'm leaving in like twenty minutes.
ex.cn: 我大概 20 分钟后离开。

ex.en: It's going to cost like a hundred dollars.
ex.cn: 这可能要花 100 美元。

senses.def: used in very informal speech, to mean 'I say', 'he/she says', etc.

ex.en: And then I'm like 'No Way!'
ex.cn: 接着我说 “没门儿！”

senses.def: used in informal speech instead of as to say that sth happens in the same way
senses.chn: （非正式口语，代替 as）和…一样，如，像

ex.en: There was silence, but not like before.
ex.cn: 没有声音，但与以前不一样。

ex.en: He has blue eyes like me.
ex.cn: 他和我一样有双蓝眼睛。

ex.en: She enjoys all kinds of music, as I do.
ex.cn: 她和我一样什么音乐都喜欢。

ex.en: Repeat these five steps, as in the last exercise.
ex.cn: 照前面的练习一样，重复这五个步骤。

ex.en: Nobody understands him like I do.
ex.cn: 谁都不像我那么了解他。

ex.en: I don't want to upset him again like before.
ex.cn: 我不愿意再像过去那样使他扫兴。

senses.def: quite probably

ex.en: She would be in bed by now, as like as not.
ex.cn: 这时候她很可能睡了。

example.en: She's nice. I like her.
example.cn: 她人很好，我喜欢她。

example.en: She's never liked swimming.
example.cn: 她从不喜欢游泳。

example.en: I didn't like him taking all the credit.
example.cn: 我讨厌他把所有的功劳归于自己。

example.en: I like to see them enjoying themselves.
example.cn: 我就愿意看着他们玩得高兴。

example.en: I like it when you do that.
example.cn: 我喜欢你那样做。

example.en: I like my coffee strong.
example.cn: 咖啡我爱喝浓的。

example.en: Would you like a drink?
example.cn: 你想喝一杯吗？

example.en: We'd like you to come and visit us.
example.cn: 我们想请你来我们这儿做客。

phrases.filled: like for sb to do sth

example.en: I'd like for us to work together.
example.cn: 我希望我们在一起工作。

senses.def: so unpleasant that you cannot believe it is true

ex.en: In broad daylight the events of the night before seemed like a bad dream.
ex.cn: 在大白天里，前一天夜里发生的事情就像噩梦般令人难以置信。

like a bat out of hell.lemma: like a bat out of hell

senses.def: very fast

like a bear with a sore head.lemma: like a bear with a sore head

senses.def: bad-tempered or in a bad-tempered way
pleasant and easy to like

ex.en: a very likeable man
ex.cn: 十分讨人喜爱的人

like a cat on hot bricks.lemma: like a cat on hot bricks

senses.def: very nervous
senses.chn: 局促不安；如坐针毡；像热锅上的蚂蚁

ex.en: She was like a cat on hot bricks before her driving test.
ex.cn: 她考驾驶执照前十分紧张不安。

like a cat that's got the cream.lemma: like a cat that's got the cream

senses.def: very pleased with yourself
very fast and easily
easily; without meeting any difficulty
very much

ex.en: They're always slagging me off like anything.
ex.cn: 他们经常把我骂得狗血淋头。

senses.def: very quickly and without hesitating

ex.en: If I had the chance to go there, I'd go like a shot.
ex.cn: 要是我有机会去那儿，我会毫不犹豫就去的。

senses.def: very heavily; very severely

ex.en: Disappointment hit her like a ton of bricks.
ex.cn: 她大失所望。

ex.en: They came down on him like a ton of bricks (= criticized him very severely).
ex.cn: 他们狠狠批评了他一顿。

senses.def: very hard; very fast
quite probably

ex.en: She would be in bed by now, as like as not.
ex.cn: 这时候她很可能睡了。

senses.def: with great effort, power, speed, etc.
with a lot of energy and enthusiasm
difficult to find or obtain

ex.en: Tickets for the final are like gold dust.
ex.cn: 决赛票很难弄到。

senses.def: used for emphasis

ex.en: She worked like hell for her exams.
ex.cn: 她为了考试而拼命复习。

ex.en: My broken finger hurt like hell.
ex.cn: 我的手指骨折，痛得要命。

senses.def: used when you are refusing permission or saying that sth is not true

ex.en: 'I'm coming with you.' 'Like hell you are.' (= you certainly are not)
ex.cn: “我要和你一起去。” “鬼才信呢。”

senses.def: used to describe a very difficult task, especially one that involves organizing people
senses.chn: 如牧猫般困难（形容非常难的任务，尤涉及对人的组织管理）

ex.en: Managing a political party is a lot like herding cats.
ex.cn: 管理一个政党很像放牧一群猫，极为困难。

like it's going out of fashion.lemma: like it's going out of fashion

senses.def: used to emphasize that sb is doing sth or using sth a lot
senses.chn: 做得很多；大量使用；大肆花费

ex.en: She's been spending money like it's going out of fashion.
ex.cn: 她花钱一直大手大脚。

senses.def: the chance of sth happening; how likely sth is to happen

ex.en: There is very little likelihood of that happening.
ex.cn: 几乎没有发生那种事情的可能。

ex.en: In all likelihood (= very probably) the meeting will be cancelled.
ex.cn: 这次会议十有八九要被取消。

ex.en: The likelihood is that (= it is likely that) unemployment figures will continue to fall.
ex.cn: 很有可能失业人数会继续下降。

senses.def: probable or expected
senses.chn: 可能的；预料的；有希望的

ex.en: the most likely outcome
ex.cn: 最可能的结果

ex.en: Tickets are likely to be expensive.
ex.cn: 入场券可能很贵。

ex.en: It's more than likely that the thieves don't know how much it is worth.
ex.cn: 盗贼很可能不知道此物的价值。

ex.en: They might refuse to let us do it, but it's hardly likely.
ex.cn: 他们也许不会让我们做这工作，但这可能性太小。

ex.en: It's pretty much inevitable that prices will go up this year.
ex.cn: 今年价格上涨几乎是不可避免的了。

ex.en: I think it's likely to rain this afternoon.
ex.cn: 我觉得今天下午有可能下雨。

senses.def: seeming suitable for a purpose
senses.chn: 似乎合适的；仿佛恰当的

ex.en: She seems the most likely candidate for the job.
ex.cn: 这项工作，她似乎是最适宜的人选了。

senses.def: used to show that you do not believe what sb has said
senses.chn: （表示不相信某人的话）说得好像真有这回事似的，煞有介事

senses.def: very probably

ex.en: As likely as not she's forgotten all about it.
ex.cn: 她很可能把这事忘得一干二净了。

ex.en: We will most likely see him later.
ex.cn: 我们很可能晚些时候会见到他。

ex.en: The deal will likely result in more cuts to services.
ex.cn: 这项协议可能会导致对服务行业的进一步削减。

ex.en: We will likely see him later.
ex.cn: 我们可能晚些时候会见到他。

ex.en: He said that he would likely run for President.
ex.cn: 他说他可能竞选总统。

senses.def: used to disagree strongly with a statement or suggestion
senses.chn: （表示坚决不同意）决不可能，绝对不会

ex.en: Me? Join the army? Not likely!
ex.cn: 我？参军入伍？不可能！

example.en: Tickets are likely to be expensive.
example.cn: 入场券可能很贵。

example.en: It's more than likely that the thieves don't know how much it is worth.
example.cn: 盗贼很可能不知道此物的价值。

senses.def: having similar ideas and interests
senses.chn: 想法相同的；志趣相投的

senses.def: to compare one thing or person to another and say they are similar

ex.en: Life is often likened to a journey.
ex.cn: 人们常把人生比作旅程。

senses.def: the fact of being similar to another person or thing, especially in appearance; an example of this

ex.en: Joanna bears a strong likeness to her father.
ex.cn: 乔安娜长得酷似她父亲。

ex.en: Do you notice any family likeness between them?
ex.cn: 你看没看出他们长得像是一家人？

senses.def: a painting, drawing, etc. of a person, especially one that looks very like them

ex.en: The drawing is said to be a good likeness of the girl's attacker.
ex.cn: 据说那幅嫌犯的画像画得很像袭击女孩的歹徒本人。

senses.def: in very good condition, as it was when it was new

ex.en: I've had your coat cleaned—it's as good as new now.
ex.cn: 你的外套洗好了，像新的一样。

senses.def: very much, very fast, very well, etc.

ex.en: I've been working like nobody's business to get it finished in time.
ex.cn: 为按时完成任务，我一直在快马加鞭地工作。

senses.def: with a lot of force or energy
senses.chn: 着了魔似的；拼命地；猛烈地

ex.en: He flew out of the room like a man possessed.

ex.en: He hung the towels out on the line (= clothes line).
ex.cn: 他把那些毛巾挂在晒衣绳上。

ex.en: They dropped the sails and threw a line to a man on the dock.
ex.cn: 他们放下风帆，把船缆抛给码头上的人。

senses.def: a pipe or thick wire that carries water, gas or electricity from one place to another
a telephone connection; a particular telephone number

ex.en: Your bill includes line rental.
ex.cn: 你的账单包括电话线路的租用费。

ex.en: The company's lines have been jammed (= busy) all day with people making complaints.
ex.cn: 公司的电话整天都因人们打投诉电话而占线。

ex.en: I was talking to John when the line suddenly went dead.
ex.cn: 我正和约翰谈话，突然电话断了。

ex.en: If you hold the line (= stay on the telephone and wait), I'll see if she is available.
ex.cn: 请你不要挂断电话，我去看看她能不能接电话。

senses.def: a railway/railroad track; a section of a railway/railroad system
senses.chn: 轨道；铁道；（铁路的）段，线路

ex.en: The train was delayed because a tree had fallen across the line.
ex.cn: 火车晚点是因为有一棵树横倒在铁轨上。

ex.en: a branch line
ex.cn: 铁路支线

ex.en: the East Coast line
ex.cn: 东海岸铁路线

senses.def: the direction that sb/sth is moving or located in

ex.en: Just keep going in a straight line; you can't miss it.
ex.cn: 只管照直走，你不会找不到那地方的。

ex.en: The town is in a direct line between London and the coast.
ex.cn: 这个镇在伦敦与海岸之间的直线上。

ex.en: Please move; you're right in my line of vision (= the direction I am looking in).
ex.cn: 请挪动一下，你正好挡住了我的视线。

ex.en: They followed the line of the river for three miles.
ex.cn: 他们沿着那条河走了三英里。

ex.en: Be careful to stay out of the line of fire (= the direction sb is shooting in).
ex.cn: 注意待在射击路线以外。

senses.def: a route from one place to another especially when it is used for a particular purpose

ex.en: Their aim was to block guerrilla supply lines.
ex.cn: 他们的目的是封锁游击队的供给线。

senses.def: an attitude or a belief, especially one that sb states publicly

ex.en: The government is taking a firm line on terrorism.
ex.cn: 政府现在对恐怖主义采取强硬的态度。

ex.en: He supported the official line on education.
ex.cn: 他支持官方的教育理念。

senses.def: a method or way of doing or thinking about sth

ex.en: I don't follow your line of reasoning.
ex.cn: 我不理解你的推理方法。

ex.en: She decided to try a different line of argument (= way of persuading sb of sth).
ex.cn: 她决定换一种说理方式。

ex.en: sb's first line of attack/defence
ex.cn: 某人进行抨击／辩护的第一着

ex.en: The police are pursuing a new line of enquiry/inquiry (= way of finding out information).
ex.cn: 警方正在实施一种新的调查方法。

senses.def: a type or area of business, activity or interest

ex.en: My line of work pays pretty well.
ex.cn: 我的职业报酬颇丰厚。

ex.en: You can't do much in the art line without training.
ex.cn: 没经过训练，你在艺术行业是不会有多大作为的。

senses.def: a type of product

ex.en: We are starting a new line in casual clothes.
ex.cn: 我们将着手经营一组新的休闲服系列。

ex.en: Some lines sell better than others.
ex.cn: 有些品种的货物销售得好些，有些则较差。

senses.def: a company that provides transport for people or goods

ex.en: a shipping/bus line
ex.cn: 航运／公共汽车公司

senses.def: a row or series of military defences where the soldiers are fighting during a war

ex.en: The regiment was sent to fight in the front line (= the position nearest the enemy).
ex.cn: 这个团被派到前线作战。

ex.en: They were trapped behind enemy lines (= in the area controlled by the enemy).
ex.cn: 他们在敌人后方遭到围困。

senses.def: an amount of cocaine that is spread out in a thin line, ready to take
senses.chn: （准备吸用的）散放成一条细线的可卡因

senses.def: at some point during an activity or a process
senses.chn: 在某一环节；在某一时刻

ex.en: Somewhere along the line a large amount of money went missing.
ex.cn: 有一笔巨款在某一环节上不翼而飞。

ex.en: We'll make a decision on that further down the line.
ex.cn: 我们将在以后的阶段对此问题作出决策。

senses.def: in the way that is mentioned

ex.en: The new system will operate along the same lines as the old one.
ex.cn: 新系统的运作方式将与旧系统一样。

ex.en: They voted along class lines.
ex.cn: 他们按各社会等级进行投票。

senses.def: similar to the way or thing that is mentioned
senses.chn: 类似于（提及的方式或东西）

ex.en: Those aren't his exact words, but he said something along those lines.
ex.cn: 那些不是他的原话，但他说的大致就是这个意思。

senses.def: to be working or functioning

ex.en: The new working methods will come on line in June.
ex.cn: 新的操作方法将在六月实行。

senses.def: using or connected to a computer or the Internet; communicating with other people by computer

ex.en: All the new homes are on line.
ex.cn: 所有的新建住宅都已联机。

senses.def: to behave or make sb/sth behave in the same way as other people or how they should behave
senses.chn: 使一致；使规范；使符合；（和…）一致

ex.en: Britain must be brought into line with the rest of Europe on taxes.
ex.cn: 英国必须在税收上与其他欧洲国家达成一致。

senses.def: in a position that forms a straight line with sth

ex.en: An eclipse happens when the earth and moon are in line with the sun.
ex.cn: 地球和月亮与太阳处在一条直线上就会发生日食或月食。

senses.def: likely to get sth

ex.en: She is in line for promotion.
ex.cn: 她有可能得到提升。

senses.def: while doing a job
senses.chn: 在执行任务时；在履行职责时

ex.en: A policeman was injured in the line of duty yesterday.
ex.cn: 昨天有一名警察在执行公务时受伤。

senses.def: similar to sth or so that one thing is closely connected with another

ex.en: Annual pay increases will be in line with inflation.
ex.cn: 每年加薪幅度将与通货膨胀挂钩。

senses.def: to tell sb clearly what you think, especially when they will not like what you say

ex.en: The manager laid it on the line—some people would have to lose their jobs.
ex.cn: 经理开门见山地说，有些人将要失去工作。

senses.def: (to choose, etc.) the easiest way of doing sth
at risk

ex.en: If we don't make a profit, my job is on the line.
ex.cn: 我们要是赚不了钱，我就有失业的危险。

senses.def: not forming a straight line
different from sth
senses.chn: 与…不同（或不一致）；不符合

ex.en: London prices are way out of line with the rest of the country.
ex.cn: 伦敦的物价与英国其他地方的有很大的差异。

senses.def: behaving in a way that is not acceptable or right
senses.chn: 行为不当；举止让人难以接受

senses.def: to be in a difficult or dangerous situation where you could easily make a mistake
senses.chn: 处于困境（或险境）；如履薄冰；走钢丝

ex.en: He was walking a fine line between being funny and being rude.
ex.cn: 他想滑稽而不粗鲁，难以把握分寸。

senses.def: used to say that people or groups have shown which side they intend to support in an argument or contest that is going to begin
senses.chn: 战线已经划清（指争战之际各拥一方形成对垒之势）

senses.def: to say that sth is finished and not worth discussing any more
(to reach) the point at which sth can no longer continue in the same way

ex.en: A defeat in the second round marked the end of the line for last year's champion.
ex.cn: 第二局的失利表明去年的冠军得主已卫冕无望。

senses.def: to be in a position where you can be shot at
to be in a position where people can criticize or blame you
senses.chn: 处于易受批评（或责备）的地位

ex.en: The employment secretary found himself in the firing line over recent job cuts.
ex.cn: 劳工部长因近期的工作岗位削减而备受责难。

senses.def: strong control or discipline
senses.chn: 牢固控制；严格纪律；铁腕

ex.en: Those children need a firm hand to make them behave.
ex.cn: 那些孩子得严加管教。

senses.def: doing work that will have an important effect on sth
senses.chn: 在最重要的岗位上；在第一线

ex.en: a life spent in the front line of research
ex.cn: 在研究的第一线度过的一生

senses.def: used as a way of saying that you are sorry about sth, usually ironically(= you really mean the opposite)
senses.chn: （常作反话）太不幸了，真够倒霉

senses.def: completely

ex.en: What I said was not true, but he fell for it (= believed it) hook, line and sinker.
ex.cn: 我的话并非实话，但他完全相信了。

senses.def: to go to the front of a line of people without waiting for your turn
senses.chn: 插队；加塞儿；不按次序排队

senses.def: to behave in a way that people think is not acceptable
to tell sb a story or make an excuse that is not true
to look for or discover a meaning in sth that is not openly stated
senses.chn: 领悟隐含的意义；看出言外之意

ex.en: Reading between the lines, I think Clare needs money.
ex.cn: 斟酌一下她的言外之意，我觉得克莱尔需要钱。

senses.def: to sign a document to show that you have agreed to buy sth or do sth
senses.chn: 在签字处签上姓名（表示同意）；签名同意

ex.en: Just sign on the dotted line and the car is yours.
ex.cn: 只要在虚线上签名，这车就归你了。

senses.def: to behave badly or break the rules
senses.chn: 表现不好；不守规矩；越轨；出格

senses.def: to say or do what sb in authority tells you to say or do, even if you do not share the same opinions, etc.
senses.chn: 顺从当局（或集体）；遵循…路线

ex.en: to toe the party line
ex.cn: 遵循党的路线

senses.def: to cover the inside of sth with a layer of another material to keep it clean, make it stronger, etc.

ex.en: Line the pan with greaseproof paper.
ex.cn: 在烤盘里垫一层防油纸。

senses.def: to form a layer on the inside of sth

ex.en: the membranes that line the nose
ex.cn: 在鼻腔里形成的一层内膜

senses.def: to form lines or rows along sth

ex.en: Crowds of people lined the streets to watch the race.
ex.cn: 人群站在街道两旁观看比赛。

ex.en: The walls were lined with books.
ex.cn: 靠墙是一排排的图书。

senses.def: to get richer or make sb richer, especially by taking unfair advantage of a situation or by being dishonest
senses.chn: （尤指通过占便宜或欺诈而）中饱私囊，（使）发财

senses.def: to stand in a line or row; to form a queue/ line
senses.chn: 排成一行；站队；排队（等候）

ex.en: Line up, children!
ex.cn: 孩子们，站成一排！

ex.en: Cars lined up waiting to board the ship.
ex.cn: 汽车排队等候上船。

senses.def: to arrange people or things in a straight line or row
senses.chn: 使站成一队；使排列成一行

ex.en: The suspects were lined up against the wall.
ex.cn: 嫌疑犯靠墙站成了一排。

ex.en: He lined the bottles up along the shelf.
ex.cn: 他把瓶子排列在架子上。

senses.def: to arrange for an event or activity to happen, or arrange for sb to be available to do sth
senses.chn: 组织，安排（活动）；邀集（人做某事）

ex.en: Mark had a job lined up when he left college.
ex.cn: 马克大学毕业时，工作已经安排好了。

ex.en: I've got a lot lined up this week (= I'm very busy).
ex.cn: 我这周有许多事要做。

ex.en: She's lined up a live band for the party.
ex.cn: 她为聚会安排了一个乐队来现场演奏。

senses.def: to move one thing into a correct position in relation to another thing
senses.chn: 使…（与相关的另一物）排齐；使…对齐

example.en: The walls were lined with books.
example.cn: 靠墙是一排排的图书。

senses.def: the series of families that sb comes from originally
coming in a direct line from an earlier or later generation of the same family as sb

ex.en: a lineal descendant of the company's founder
ex.cn: 公司创始人的直系后裔

senses.def: the typical features of sth
of or in lines

ex.en: In his art he broke the laws of scientific linear perspective.
ex.cn: 他在自己的绘画艺术中打破了科学的直线透视法规律。

senses.def: going from one thing to another in a single series of stages

ex.en: Students do not always progress in a linear fashion.
ex.cn: 学生的进步不会总是直线式的。

senses.def: of length

ex.en: linear measurement (= for example metres, feet, etc.)
ex.cn: 长度测量

senses.def: able to be represented by a straight line on a graph

ex.en: linear equations
ex.cn: 线性方程

senses.def: a defensive player who tries to tackle members of the other team
caught with a hook, not in a net

ex.en: We sell only line-caught wild fish.
ex.cn: 我们只卖钓来的野生鱼。

senses.def: having folds or lines because of age, worry, etc.

ex.en: a deeply lined face
ex.cn: 布满深深皱纹的脸

senses.def: having lines printed or drawn across it

ex.en: Lined paper helps keep handwriting neat.
ex.cn: 印有横线的纸有助于书写工整。

senses.def: having a lining inside them

ex.en: a lined skirt
ex.cn: 带衬里的裙子

senses.def: having the object mentioned along an edge or edges, or as a lining
senses.chn: 沿边缘有…的；有…做衬里的

ex.en: a tree-lined road
ex.cn: 两旁栽着树的马路

senses.def: a type of dancing originally from the US, in which people dance in lines, all doing a complicated series of steps at the same time
a drawing that consists only of lines
a powerful hit in a straight line near to the ground
senses.chn: 平直球，平飞球（贴近地面猛力击打的直线球）

senses.def: a player in the front line of an American football team
senses.chn: （美式足球的）前锋，线上的队员

senses.def: the system of organizing a company, etc. in which information and instructions are passed from each employee and manager to the person one rank above or below them
a type of cloth made from flax, used to make high-quality clothes, sheets, etc.

ex.en: a linen tablecloth
ex.cn: 亚麻桌布

senses.def: sheets, tablecloths, pillowcases, etc.

ex.en: a linen cupboard
ex.cn: 家庭日用织品壁橱

ex.en: a linen closet
ex.cn: 家庭日用织品壁橱

senses.def: to discuss your personal affairs in public, especially sth embarrassing
senses.chn: 公开谈论个人的事；（尤指）家丑外扬

senses.def: an imaginary line that goes from sb's eye to sth that they are looking at

ex.en: There was a column directly in my line of sight, so I could only see half the stage.
ex.cn: 有一根柱子正挡着我的视线，所以我只能看见舞台的一半。

senses.def: a situation that happens when the ball goes out of play, when players from opposing teams stand in lines and jump to try to catch the ball when it is thrown back in
senses.chn: （球出界后再抛球入场时的）争边球

senses.def: a machine that prints very quickly, producing a complete line of print at a time
a large ship that carries passengers

ex.en: an ocean liner
ex.cn: 远洋客轮

ex.en: a luxury cruise liner
ex.cn: 豪华游轮

senses.def: a piece of material used to cover the inside surface of sth

ex.en: bin/nappy liners
ex.cn: 衬在垃圾桶内的塑料袋；尿布衬垫

senses.def: information about the music or the performers that comes with a CD or is printed on the cover of a record
senses.chn: （激光唱片或唱片的）封套内容简介

senses.def: an official who helps the referee in football (soccer in some games that are played on a field or court, especially in deciding whether or where a ball crosses one of the lines. Linesmen are now officially called referee's assistants in football (soccer).
senses.chn: （足球等比赛中的）边线裁判员，巡边员，司线员

senses.def: a person whose job is to repair telephone or electricity power lines
to stand in a line or row; to form a queue/ line
senses.chn: 排成一行；站队；排队（等候）

ex.en: Line up, children!
ex.cn: 孩子们，站成一排！

ex.en: Cars lined up waiting to board the ship.
ex.cn: 汽车排队等候上船。

senses.def: the people who are going to take part in a particular event

ex.en: an impressive line-up of speakers
ex.cn: 给人印象深刻的演讲者阵容

ex.en: the starting line-up (= the players who will begin the game)
ex.cn: 比赛首发队员阵容

senses.def: a set of items, events etc. arranged to follow one another

ex.en: A horror movie completes this evening's TV line-up.
ex.cn: 今晚电视节目最后安排了一部恐怖影片。

senses.def: a row of people, including one person who is suspected of a crime, who are shown to a witness to see if he or she can recognize the criminal
senses.chn: 辨认行列，列队认人（把嫌疑犯同其他人排在一起，让目击者辨认）

senses.def: a low plant that is a type of heather and that grows on areas of wild open land (= moorland )
senses.chn: 欧石楠（低矮灌木，生长在荒野里）

senses.def: to continue to exist for longer than expected

ex.en: The faint smell of her perfume lingered in the room.
ex.cn: 房间里仍飘溢着她那淡淡的香水味。

ex.en: The civil war lingered on well into the 1930s.
ex.cn: 这次内战到 20 世纪 30 年代还拖了好几年。

senses.def: to stay somewhere for longer because you do not want to leave; to spend a long time doing sth
senses.chn: 流连；逗留；徘徊；花很长时间做（某事）；磨蹭

ex.en: She lingered for a few minutes to talk to Nick.
ex.cn: 她多待了几分钟，想跟尼克谈一谈。

ex.en: We lingered over breakfast on the terrace.
ex.cn: 我们在平台上慢条斯理地吃着早餐。

senses.def: to continue to look at sb/sth or think about sth for longer than usual

ex.en: His eyes lingered on the diamond ring on her finger.
ex.cn: 他一直注视着她手指上的钻戒。

senses.def: to stay alive but become weaker

ex.en: He lingered on for several months after the heart attack.
ex.cn: 他心脏病发作后又拖了几个月才去世。

example.en: The civil war lingered on well into the 1930s.
example.cn: 这次内战到 20 世纪 30 年代还拖了好几年。

senses.def: women's underwear
slow to end or disappear
senses.chn: 拖延的；缠绵的；缓慢消失的；迟迟不去的

ex.en: a painful and lingering death
ex.cn: 痛苦而拖延时日的死亡

ex.en: a last lingering look
ex.cn: 依依不舍的最后一瞥

ex.en: lingering doubts
ex.cn: 挥之不去的疑虑

ex.en: a lingering smell of machine oil
ex.cn: 飘浮不散的机油味

senses.def: a language, especially a foreign language
senses.chn: 语言；（尤指）外国语，外国话

ex.en: He doesn't speak the lingo.
ex.cn: 他不会讲这种外国话。

senses.def: expressions used by a particular group of people

ex.en: baseball lingo
ex.cn: 棒球术语

senses.def: a shared language of communication used between people whose main languages are different
senses.chn: （母语不同的人共用的）通用语

ex.en: English has become a lingua franca in many parts of the world.
ex.cn: 英语在世界上许多地方都成了通用语。

senses.def: related to the tongue
related to speech or language
produced using the tongue
a person who knows several foreign languages well

ex.en: She's an excellent linguist.
ex.cn: 她精通数国语言。

ex.en: I'm afraid I'm no linguist (= I find foreign languages difficult).
ex.cn: 对不起，我不懂外语。

senses.def: a person who studies languages or linguistics
connected with language or the scientific study of language

ex.en: linguistic and cultural barriers
ex.cn: 语言和文化上的障碍

ex.en: a child's innate linguistic ability
ex.cn: 儿童的先天语言能力

ex.en: new developments in linguistic theory
ex.cn: 语言学理论的新发展

senses.def: the scientific study of language or of particular languages

ex.en: a course in applied linguistics
ex.cn: 应用语言学课程

senses.def: a liquid, especially one made with oil, that you rub on a painful part of your body to reduce the pain
senses.chn: （尤指油质、镇痛的）搽剂，擦剂；镇痛油

senses.def: a layer of material used to cover the inside surface of sth

ex.en: a pair of leather gloves with fur linings
ex.cn: 一双毛皮衬里的皮手套

senses.def: the covering of the inner surface of a part of the body

ex.en: the stomach lining
ex.cn: 胃黏膜

senses.def: every sad or difficult situation has a positive side
senses.chn: 黑暗中总有一线光明；朵朵乌云衬银边，处处黑暗透光明

senses.def: a connection between two or more people or things

ex.en: Police suspect there may be a link between the two murders.
ex.cn: 警方怀疑那两桩凶杀案可能有关联。

ex.en: evidence for a strong causal link between exposure to sun and skin cancer
ex.cn: 太阳暴晒与皮肤癌之间有紧密因果关系的证据

senses.def: a relationship between two or more people, countries or organizations

ex.en: to establish trade links with Asia
ex.cn: 与亚洲建立贸易关系

ex.en: Social customs provide a vital link between generations.
ex.cn: 社会风俗在不同世代之间起到了极其重要的纽带作用。

senses.def: a means of travelling or communicating between two places

ex.en: a high-speed rail link
ex.cn: 高速的铁路交通

ex.en: a link road
ex.cn: 连接道路

ex.en: a video link
ex.cn: 视频线路

ex.en: The speech was broadcast via a satellite link.
ex.cn: 这次演讲是通过卫星播放的。
