ex.cn: 可赢取的奖品真的有好几百份。

senses.def: used to emphasize a word or phrase, even if it is not actually true in a literal sense
senses.chn: （用于加强语气，虽然并非词语的字面意义）简直

ex.en: I literally jumped out of my skin.
ex.cn: 我简直给吓了一大跳。

senses.def: connected with literature

ex.en: literary criticism/theory
ex.cn: 文学批评／理论

senses.def: suitable for or typical of a work of literature
senses.chn: 适于文学作品的；有典型文学作品特征的

ex.en: It was Chaucer who really turned English into a literary language.
ex.cn: 是乔叟使英语真正变成了文学语言。

senses.def: liking literature very much; studying or writing literature
senses.chn: 爱好文学的；从事文学研究（或写作）的

ex.en: a literary man
ex.cn: 文人

senses.def: a person whose job is to represent authors and persuade companies to publish their work
senses.chn: 作品经纪人，作家代理人（说服出版社出版作品）

senses.def: able to read and write
senses.chn: 有读写能力的；有文化的

senses.def: educated and intelligent people who enjoy literature
pieces of writing that are valued as works of art, especially novels, plays and poems (in contrast to technical books and newspapers, magazines, etc.)

ex.en: French literature
ex.cn: 法国文学

ex.en: great works of literature
ex.cn: 文学巨著

senses.def: pieces of writing or printed information on a particular subject

ex.en: I've read all the available literature on keeping rabbits.
ex.cn: 我阅读了我能找到的关于养兔的全部资料。

ex.en: sales literature
ex.cn: 推销商品的宣传资料

senses.def: moving or bending easily, in a way that is elegant
senses.chn: 优美柔软的；易弯曲的；柔韧性好

senses.def: a chemical element. Lithium is a soft, very light, silver-white metal used in batteries and alloys.
a picture printed by lithography
the process of printing from a smooth surface, for example a metal plate, that has been specially prepared so that ink only sticks to the design to be printed
the study of the general physical characteristics of rocks
the layer of rock that forms the outer part of the earth
a country in eastern Europe
(a person) from Lithuania
senses.chn: 立陶宛人；立陶宛的；立陶宛人的

senses.def: a person who is making or defending a claim in court
to take a claim or disagreement to court
the process of making or defending a claim in court

ex.en: The company has been in litigation with its previous auditors for a full year.
ex.cn: 那家公司与前任审计员已打了整整一年的官司。

senses.def: too ready to take disagreements to court
a substance that turns red when it touches an acid and blue when it touches an alkali
senses.chn: 石蕊（一种遇酸变红而遇碱则变蓝的物质）

ex.en: litmus paper
ex.cn: 石蕊试纸

senses.def: a test using litmus
the use of a negative or weak statement to emphasize a positive meaning, for example he wasn't slow to accept the offer (= he was quick to accept the offer)
senses.chn: 反叙法，曲言（用否定或较弱的语气加强表示肯定）

senses.def: a unit for measuring volume, equal to 1.76 British pints or 2.11 American pints
senses.chn: 升（容量单位，等于英国的 1.76 品脱或美国的 2.11 品脱）

ex.en: 3 litres of water
ex.cn: 3 升水

ex.en: a litre bottle of wine
ex.cn: 一升容量的瓶装酒

ex.en: a car with a 3.5 litre engine
ex.cn: 配有 3.5 升发动机的汽车

senses.def: small pieces of rubbish/garbage such as paper, cans and bottles, that people have left lying in a public place
senses.chn: （在公共场所乱扔的）垃圾，废弃物，杂物

ex.en: There will be fines for people who drop litter.
ex.cn: 乱扔垃圾的人将被罚款。

senses.def: a number of things that are lying in an untidy way
senses.chn: 乱七八糟的东西；乱放的杂物

ex.en: The floor was covered with a litter of newspapers, clothes and empty cups.
ex.cn: 地板上到处都是乱七八糟的报纸、衣服和空杯子。

senses.def: a dry substance that is put in a shallow open box for pets, especially cats, to use as a toilet when they are indoors
senses.chn: （供宠物，尤指猫，在室内便溺的）猫砂，便溺垫物

ex.en: cat litter
ex.cn: 猫砂

ex.en: a litter tray
ex.cn: 猫砂盘

ex.en: a litter box
ex.cn: 铺了便溺垫物的箱子

senses.def: a number of baby animals that one mother gives birth to at the same time

ex.en: a litter of puppies
ex.cn: 一窝小狗

ex.en: the runt (= the smallest and weakest baby) of the litter
ex.cn: 一窝中最弱小的幼畜

senses.def: the substance, especially straw, that is used for farm animals to sleep on
senses.chn: （供牲畜睡卧用的）垫草，褥草，铺栏草

senses.def: a kind of chair or bed that was used in the past for carrying important people
to be spread around a place, making it look untidy

ex.en: Piles of books and newspapers littered the floor.
ex.cn: 地板上乱七八糟地堆了许多书和报纸。

ex.en: Broken glass littered the streets.
ex.cn: 街上到处是玻璃碎片。

senses.def: to leave things in a place, making it look untidy

ex.en: The floor was littered with papers.
ex.cn: 地板上乱七八糟扔了许多文件。

ex.en: He was arrested for littering.
ex.cn: 他因乱扔垃圾被拘捕。

senses.def: to contain or involve a lot of a particular type of thing, usually sth bad
senses.chn: 使饱含，使遍布（一般指不好的东西）

ex.en: Your essay is littered with spelling mistakes.
ex.cn: 你的文章里到处是拼写错误。

senses.def: a container for people to put rubbish/garbage in, in the street or in a public building
senses.chn: （街道上或公共建筑物里的）垃圾箱，废物箱

senses.def: a person who leaves litter in public places
senses.chn: （在公共场所）乱扔垃圾的人；垃圾虫

senses.def: not big; small; smaller than others

ex.en: a little house
ex.cn: 小房子

ex.en: a little group of tourists
ex.cn: 一小群游客

ex.en: a little old lady
ex.cn: 一位小老太太

ex.en: the classic little black dress
ex.cn: 典雅的黑色小连衣裙

ex.en: 'Which do you want?' 'I'll take the little one.'
ex.cn: “你要哪一个？” “我要那个小的。”

ex.en: She gave a little laugh.
ex.cn: 她笑了一笑。

senses.def: used after an adjective to show affection or dislike, especially in a patronizing way (= one that suggests that you think you are better than sb)
senses.chn: （用在形容词的后面表示喜爱或厌恶，尤指屈尊俯就地）可爱的，可怜的，讨厌的

ex.en: The poor little thing! It's lost its mother.
ex.cn: 这可怜的小家伙！没有了妈妈。

ex.en: What a nasty little man!
ex.cn: 多么令人讨厌的家伙！

ex.en: She's a good little worker.
ex.cn: 她是个讨人喜欢的工人。

ex.en: He'd become quite the little gentleman.
ex.cn: 他成了颇有风度的绅士了。

senses.def: young

ex.en: a little boy/girl
ex.cn: 小男孩；小女孩

ex.en: my little brother/sister (= younger brother/sister)
ex.cn: 我的弟弟／妹妹

ex.en: I lived in America when I was little.
ex.cn: 我小时候生活在美国。

senses.def: short

ex.en: A little while later the phone rang.
ex.cn: 过了一小会儿电话响了起来。

ex.en: Shall we walk a little way?
ex.cn: 我们走一小段路好吗？

senses.def: not important; not serious

ex.en: I can't remember every little detail.
ex.cn: 我记不住每一个微小的细节。

ex.en: You soon get used to the little difficulties.
ex.cn: 你很快就会习惯这些小小的不便了。

senses.def: used to say that sb told you sth but you do not want to say who it was
senses.chn: （不想说出是谁告诉的）有人告诉我的，不告诉你我是怎么知道的

senses.def: something large and successful often begins in a very small way
senses.chn: 参天橡树长自小小橡实；合抱之树，生于毫末

senses.def: to have a very good effect on sb/sth
senses.chn: （为某人或替某事）创造奇迹；产生神奇作用

ex.en: The news has done wonders for our morale.
ex.cn: 这消息大大振奋了我们的士气。

senses.def: used with uncountable nouns to mean 'not much'

ex.en: There was little doubt in my mind.
ex.cn: 我心里几乎没有疑问。

ex.en: Students have little or no choice in the matter.
ex.cn: 学生在这个问题上很少有或没有选择余地。

ex.en: I understood little of what he said.
ex.cn: 我几乎听不懂他讲的。

ex.en: She said little or nothing (= hardly anything) about her experience.
ex.cn: 她对自己的经历几乎只字不提。

ex.en: Tell him as little as possible.
ex.cn: 尽量少告诉他。

senses.def: used with uncountable nouns to mean 'a small amount', 'some'
senses.chn: （与不可数名词连用）少量的，一些

ex.en: a little milk/sugar/tea
ex.cn: 少许牛奶／糖／茶

ex.en: If you have any spare milk, could you give me a little?
ex.cn: 你要是有多余的牛奶，给我一些好吗？

ex.en: I've only read a little of the book so far.
ex.cn: 这本书我才读了一小部分。

ex.en: It caused not a little/no little (= a lot of) confusion.
ex.cn: 这事引起了不小的混乱。

ex.en: After a little (= a short time) he got up and left.
ex.cn: 过了一会儿他站起来走了。

senses.def: slowly; gradually
senses.chn: 缓慢地；逐渐地；一点一点地

ex.en: Little by little the snow disappeared.
ex.cn: 雪渐渐融化了。

ex.en: His English is improving little by little.
ex.cn: 他的英语正在逐步提高。

senses.def: not much; only slightly

ex.en: He is little known as an artist.
ex.cn: 几乎没人知道他是个艺术家。

ex.en: I slept very little last night.
ex.cn: 昨晚我几乎没怎么睡。

ex.en: Little did I know that this spelled the end of my career.
ex.cn: 我一点也没想到这会断送了我的职业生涯。

senses.def: to a small degree

ex.en: She seemed a little afraid of going inside.
ex.cn: 她好像有点害怕进去。

ex.en: These shoes are a little (bit) too big for me.
ex.cn: 我穿这双鞋太大了一点。

ex.en: Everything has become just that little bit harder.
ex.cn: 一切都变得有点更艰难了。

ex.en: She felt tired and more than a little worried.
ex.cn: 她感到既疲劳又非常担忧。

ex.en: These shoes are a bit tight.
ex.cn: 这鞋有点儿紧。

ex.en: I'll be a bit later home tomorrow.
ex.cn: 明天我要晚点儿回家。

senses.def: slowly; gradually
senses.chn: 缓慢地；逐渐地；一点一点地

ex.en: Little by little the snow disappeared.
ex.cn: 雪渐渐融化了。

ex.en: His English is improving little by little.
ex.cn: 他的英语正在逐步提高。

senses.def: an English person who believes England (or, in practice, Britain) should not get involved in international affairs
senses.chn: 英格兰本土主义者（主张英国不参与国际事务）

senses.def: the smallest finger of the hand
to persuade sb to do anything that you want
senses.chn: 任意摆布某人；左右某人

senses.def: a baseball league for children
all the people in a country who have no power
extremely small people, who will never grow to a normal size because of a physical problem
senses.chn: 异常矮小的人；侏儒；“袖珍” 人

senses.def: small imaginary people with magic powers
the capital and largest city of the US state of Arkansas
senses.chn: 小石城（美国阿肯色州首府和最大城市）

senses.def: the part of a country that is near the coast
a fixed form of public worship used in churches
to have your home in a particular place

ex.en: to live in a house
ex.cn: 住在一座房子里

ex.en: Where do you live?
ex.cn: 你住在什么地方？

ex.en: She needs to find somewhere to live.
ex.cn: 她需要找个住的地方。

ex.en: We used to live in London.
ex.cn: 我们过去住在伦敦。

ex.en: Both her children still live at home.
ex.cn: 她的两个孩子仍住在家里。

ex.en: Where do these plates live (= where are they usually kept)?
ex.cn: 这些盘子通常放哪儿？

senses.def: to remain alive

ex.en: The doctors said he only had six months to live.
ex.cn: 医生说他只能活六个月了。

ex.en: Spiders can live for several days without food.
ex.cn: 蜘蛛几天不吃食依然可存活。

ex.en: She lived to see her first grandchild.
ex.cn: 她一直活到抱上第一个孙子。

senses.def: to be alive, especially at a particular time

ex.en: When did Handel live?
ex.cn: 亨德尔是什么时期的人？

ex.en: He's the greatest player who ever lived.
ex.cn: 他是史上最出色的运动员。

senses.def: to spend your life in a particular way

ex.en: He lived in poverty most of his life.
ex.cn: 他大半辈子过的都是穷日子。

ex.en: She lived a very peaceful life.
ex.cn: 她过着十分宁静的生活。

ex.en: She lived and died a single woman.
ex.cn: 她过了一辈子的独身生活。

senses.def: to continue to exist or be remembered

ex.en: This moment will live in our memory for many years to come.
ex.cn: 这一时刻将在我们的记忆中留存许多年。

ex.en: Her words have lived with me all my life.
ex.cn: 她的话我一辈子都铭记着。

senses.def: to have a full and exciting life
senses.chn: 享受充实而令人兴奋的生活

ex.en: I don't want to be stuck in an office all my life—I want to live!
ex.cn: 我不想一辈子都憋在办公室里，我要享受人生乐趣！

senses.def: to be very enthusiastic about sth

ex.en: He just lives and breathes football.
ex.cn: 他非常热衷于足球。

senses.def: used to say that you should accept other people's opinions and behaviour even though they are different from your own
senses.chn: 自己活也让别人活；宽以待人；互相宽容

senses.def: to earn money by clever or sometimes dishonest means
senses.chn: 靠耍小聪明赚钱；（有时）靠玩花招捞钱

senses.def: to spend all the money you earn on basic needs such as food without being able to save any money
to behave as though society, etc. has not changed, when in fact it has
to live together and have a sexual relationship without being married
to enjoy yourself in an exciting way, usually spending a lot of money
senses.chn: 尽情欢乐；狂欢；纵情挥霍享乐

senses.def: to keep sth important about yourself a secret from other people, so that they do not know what you really think, what you are really like, etc.
senses.chn: 过两面人的生活；过骗人的生活；为人虚伪

senses.def: to have enough money to be able to afford expensive things, food, drink, etc.
senses.chn: 过奢侈的生活；锦衣玉食

senses.def: to eat whatever food you can grow, kill or find yourself
used to say that although you have failed or had a bad experience, you will continue
senses.chn: （虽已失败或经历很糟但仍要）改日再战，卷土重来

senses.def: used to tell sb that if they have not had a particular experience their life is not complete
senses.chn: （表示若没有某种经历生活便不完整）你白活了

ex.en: You've never been to New York? You haven't lived!
ex.cn: 你从未去过纽约？你真是白活了！

senses.def: used to express surprise at sth new or unexpected you have been told
senses.chn: （对得知的事物感到惊讶或意外）真是得活到老学到老，真想不到

senses.def: to still be alive after the time when you were expected to die
to be doing sth that other people are likely to soon stop you from doing
senses.chn: 做很快就会遭到制止的事；好景不长

senses.def: to have enough money to be able to live a very comfortable life
the way of life of a different social group, especially one much richer than you
senses.chn: 另一类人的生活方式（尤指比自己富有得多的人）

senses.def: to live an enjoyable and comfortable life with no problems or responsibilities
senses.chn: 无忧无虑地生活；安逸地生活；舒适愉快地生活

senses.def: used to say that you hope sb/sth will live or last for a long time
you should not criticize other people, because they will easily find ways of criticizing you
senses.chn: 身居玻璃房，投石招祸殃；自身毛病多，勿挑他人错

senses.def: if two people are in each other's pockets, they are too close to each other or spend too much time with each other
to live or sleep outdoors, usually because you have no home and no money
senses.chn: 风餐露宿（通常因为无家可归或贫穷）

ex.en: young people sleeping rough on the streets
ex.cn: 露宿街头的年轻人

senses.def: to follow a particular belief or set of principles
senses.chn: 按照（某信念或原则）生活

ex.en: That's a philosophy I could live by.
ex.cn: 那就是我所信奉的人生哲学。

senses.def: to earn money or to get the things you need by doing a particular thing
senses.chn: 靠做某事赚钱为生（或获取所需）

ex.en: a community that lives by fishing
ex.cn: 靠捕鱼为生的群体

senses.def: to be able to make people forget about sth embarrassing you have done
senses.chn: 能使人忘却（做过的令人尴尬的事）

ex.en: She felt so stupid. She'd never be able to live it down.
ex.cn: 她觉得自己做了傻事，恐怕永远无法挽回自己的面子了。

senses.def: to think that sb/sth is the main purpose of or the most important thing in your life
senses.chn: 以…为主要生活目的；为…而活着

ex.en: She lives for her work.
ex.cn: 她活着是为了工作。

ex.en: After his wife died, he had nothing to live for.
ex.cn: 妻子去世后，他便没有了生活目标。

senses.def: to live at the place where you work or study
senses.chn: 住在工作（或学习）的地方

ex.en: They have an au pair living in.
ex.cn: 他们有个互惠女生住在家里。

senses.def: to receive the money you need to live from sb/sth because you do not have any yourself

ex.en: She's still living off her parents.
ex.cn: 她还在靠父母养活。

ex.en: to live off welfare
ex.cn: 靠救济过活

senses.def: to have one particular type of food as the main thing you eat in order to live

ex.en: He seems to live off junk food.
ex.cn: 他好像靠吃垃圾食品为生。

senses.def: to continue to live or exist

ex.en: She died ten years ago but her memory lives on.
ex.cn: 她十年前就去世了，但她还留在人们的记忆中。

senses.def: to eat a particular type of food to live

ex.en: Small birds live mainly on insects.
ex.cn: 小鸟主要靠吃昆虫为生。

senses.def: to eat only or a lot of a particular type of food
senses.chn: 仅以（一种食物）为主要食物

ex.en: She lives on burgers.
ex.cn: 她只喜欢吃汉堡包。

senses.def: to have enough money for the basic things you need to live

ex.en: You can't live on forty pounds a week.
ex.cn: 你靠每周四十英镑没法过活。

senses.def: to live away from the place where you work or study
senses.chn: 不住在工作（或学习）的地方

ex.en: Some college students will have to live out.
ex.cn: 有些大学生将不得不住在校外。

senses.def: to actually do what you have only thought about doing before

ex.en: to live out your fantasies
ex.cn: 实现梦想

senses.def: to spend the rest of your life in a particular way

ex.en: He lived out his days alone.
ex.cn: 他独自度过余生。

senses.def: to experience a disaster or other unpleasant situation and survive it
senses.chn: 经历（灾难或其他困境）而幸存

ex.en: He has lived through two world wars.
ex.cn: 他经历了两次世界大战。

senses.def: to live in the same house
to share a home and have a sexual relationship without being married
to do as well as or be as good as other people expect you to
senses.chn: 达到，符合，不辜负（他人的期望）

ex.en: He failed to live up to his parents' expectations.
ex.cn: 他辜负了父母的期望。

ex.en: The team called 'The No-Hopers' certainly lived up to its name.
ex.cn: 叫做 “无望者” 的球队果真名副其实。

senses.def: to accept sth unpleasant

ex.en: I just had to learn to live with the pain.
ex.cn: 我不得不学会忍受痛苦。

senses.def: living; not dead

ex.en: live animals
ex.cn: 活动物

ex.en: the number of live births (= babies born alive)
ex.cn: 活产婴儿数

ex.en: We saw a real live rattlesnake!
ex.cn: 我们看见了一条活生生的响尾蛇！

senses.def: sent out while the event is actually happening, not recorded first and broadcast later
senses.chn: 现场直播的；实况转播的

ex.en: live coverage of the World Cup
ex.cn: 世界杯赛的实况转播

senses.def: given or made when people are watching, not recorded

ex.en: The club has live music most nights.
ex.cn: 该俱乐部大多数晚上有现场演奏的音乐。

ex.en: a live recording made at Wembley Arena
ex.cn: 温布利运动场的现场录音

ex.en: the band's new live album
ex.cn: 这个乐队新出的演唱会专辑

ex.en: It was the first interview I'd done in front of a live audience (= with people watching).
ex.cn: 那是我首次在观众面前做现场采访。

senses.def: connected to a source of electrical power

ex.en: That terminal is live.
ex.cn: 那个端子有电。

senses.def: still able to explode or light; ready for use
senses.chn: 仍可爆炸的；仍可点燃的；随时可用的

ex.en: live ammunition
ex.cn: 实弹

senses.def: live coals are burning or are still hot and red

senses.def: extra money that sb is paid for their job because they have special skills or qualifications

ex.en: The 2% loading for using the card abroad has been removed.
ex.cn: 在国外使用此卡的 2% 附加费已经取消。

senses.def: the practice of stopping the supply of electricity for a period of time because the demand is greater than the supply
senses.chn: 切负荷，减负荷，减（负）载（用电超过配电量时暂时切断电力的做法）

ex.en: a loaf of bread
ex.cn: 一条面包

ex.cn: 请给我两条白面包。

ex.en: a sliced loaf
ex.cn: 一条切片面包

ex.en: 'Why don't you want to see him again?' 'Oh, use your head!'
ex.cn: “你为什么不愿再见到他？” “唔，你好好想想吧！”

senses.def: to spend your time not doing anything, especially when you should be working
senses.chn: 游手好闲；无所事事；闲荡

ex.en: A group of kids were loafing around outside.
ex.cn: 一群小孩在外面四处游荡。

senses.def: a person who wastes their time rather than working
senses.chn: 虚度光阴者；游手好闲者；浪子；二流子

senses.def: a flat leather shoe that you can put on your foot without fastening it
good quality soil containing sand, clay and decayed vegetable matter
money that an organization such as a bank lends and sb borrows

ex.en: to take out/repay a loan (= to borrow money/pay it back)
ex.cn: 取得／偿还贷款

ex.en: bank loans with low interest rates
ex.cn: 银行低息贷款

ex.cn: 我花了三年的时间才还清我的学生贷款。

ex.en: a car loan (= a loan to buy a car)
ex.cn: 购车贷款

senses.def: the act of lending sth; the state of being lent

ex.en: I even gave her the loan of my car.
ex.cn: 我甚至把车也借给了她。

ex.en: an exhibition of paintings on loan (= borrowed) from private collections
ex.cn: 借用私人收藏品举办的画展

senses.def: to lend sth to sb, especially money

ex.en: The bank is happy to loan money to small businesses.
ex.cn: 银行乐于贷款给小型企业。

ex.en: A friend loaned me $1 000.
ex.cn: 有一位朋友借给我 1 000 美元。

senses.def: to lend a valuable object to a museum, etc.
senses.chn: 出借（贵重物品给博物馆等）

ex.en: This exhibit was kindly loaned by the artist's family.
ex.cn: 这件展品是艺术家的家人惠借而展出的。

ex.en: He loaned the museum his entire collection.
ex.cn: 他把自己的全部收藏品都借给了博物馆。

example.en: The bank is happy to loan money to small businesses.
example.cn: 银行乐于贷款给小型企业。

senses.chn: 放高利贷者；放印子钱者

senses.def: a word from another language used in its original form

ex.cn: latte 是借自意大利语的外来词。

senses.def: not willing to do sth

ex.en: He was loath to admit his mistake.
ex.cn: 他不愿承认自己的错误。

senses.def: to dislike sb/sth very much

ex.en: I loathe modern art.
ex.cn: 我很不喜欢现代艺术。

ex.en: They loathe each other.
ex.cn: 他们相互讨厌对方。

ex.en: He hates violence in any form.
ex.cn: 他憎恶任何形式的暴力。

ex.en: I've always hated cabbage.
ex.cn: 我从来都讨厌吃卷心菜。

ex.en: I don't like it when you phone me so late at night.
ex.cn: 我不喜欢你夜里这么晚给我打电话。

ex.en: I can't stand his brother.
ex.cn: 他弟弟让我受不了。

senses.def: a strong feeling of hatred

ex.en: She looked at her attacker with fear and loathing.
ex.cn: 她盯着袭击她的歹徒，既害怕又憎恨。

ex.en: Many soldiers returned with a deep loathing of war.
ex.cn: 许多士兵回来时对战争都深恶痛绝。

senses.def: extremely unpleasant; disgusting
senses.chn: 令人憎恶的；令人厌恶的；令人反感的

senses.def: to throw sth so that it goes quite high through the air

ex.en: Stones were lobbed over the wall.
ex.cn: 有人把石块扔过了围墙。

ex.en: Some kids were throwing stones at the window.
ex.cn: 有些孩子在朝窗户扔石头。

ex.en: She threw the ball and he caught it.
ex.cn: 她把球抛出来，他接住了。

ex.en: She tossed her jacket onto the bed.
ex.cn: 她把她的短上衣丢到床上。

ex.en: Rioters hurled a brick through the car's windscreen.
ex.cn: 暴徒把一块砖猛地扔向汽车，砸破了挡风玻璃。

ex.en: She flung the letter down onto the table.
ex.cn: 她把信摔在桌子上。

senses.def: to hit or kick a ball in a high curve through the air, especially so that it lands behind the person you are playing against
senses.chn: 吊高球，挑高球（尤指把球击或踢到对方的身后）

ex.en: He lobbed the ball over the defender's head.
ex.cn: 他把球高挑过防守队员的头顶。

senses.def: a large area inside the entrance of a public building where people can meet and wait

ex.cn: 旅馆大厅

senses.def: (in the British Parliament) a large hall that is open to the public and used for people to meet and talk to Members of Parliament
a group of people who try to influence politicians on a particular issue
senses.chn: （就某议题企图影响从政者的）游说团体

ex.en: The gun lobby is/are against any change in the law.
ex.cn: 赞同拥有枪支的团体反对作任何法律上的修改。

senses.def: an organized attempt by a group of people to influence politicians on a particular issue
senses.chn: （就某议题企图影响从政者的）游说

ex.en: a recent lobby of Parliament by pensioners
ex.cn: 领养老金者近来在议会的游说

senses.def: to try to influence a politician or the government and, for example, persuade them to support or oppose a change in the law

ex.en: Farmers will lobby Congress for higher subsidies.
ex.cn: 农民将游说国会提高对农业的补贴。

ex.en: Women's groups are lobbying to get more public money for children.
ex.cn: 妇女组织在游说政府，要求增加对儿童的拨款。

senses.def: a part of an organ in the body, especially the lungs or brain
senses.chn: （身体器官的）叶；（尤指）肺叶，脑叶

senses.def: a small garden plant with small blue, red or white flowers
senses.chn: 半边莲（园圃植物，花小，呈蓝、红或白色）

senses.def: in traditional African culture, a sum of money or number of cattle that a man's family pays to a woman's family in order that he can marry her
senses.chn: （非洲传统文化中男方为娶亲送给女方的）彩礼，彩牛礼

ex.en: to pay lobola
ex.cn: 出彩礼

senses.def: to perform a lobotomy on sb
to make sb less intelligent or less mentally active
a rare medical operation that cuts into part of a person's brain in order to treat mental illness

a sea creature with a hard shell, a long body divided into sections, eight legs and two large claws (= curved and pointed arms for catching and holding things). Its shell is black but turns bright red when it is boiled.
meat from a lobster, used for food
a trap for lobsters that is shaped like a basket
belonging to or connected with the particular place or area that you are talking about or with the place where you live

ex.en: a local farmer
ex.cn: 当地的农民

ex.en: A local man was accused of the murder.
ex.cn: 有一本地男子被指控为这起谋杀案的凶手。

ex.en: Our children go to the local school.
ex.cn: 我们的小孩在本地学校就读。

ex.en: a local newspaper (= one that gives local news)
ex.cn: 地方报纸

ex.en: local radio (= a radio station that broadcasts to one area only)
ex.cn: 地方广播电台

ex.en: decisions made at local rather than national level
ex.cn: 地方性而非全国性的决策

senses.def: affecting only one part of the body

ex.en: Her tooth was extracted under local anaesthetic.
ex.cn: 她的牙齿是局部麻醉下拔出的。

senses.def: a person who lives in a particular place or district

ex.en: The locals are very friendly.
ex.cn: 当地人很友好。

senses.def: a pub near where you live

ex.en: I called in at my local on the way home.
ex.cn: 我回家途中去了我住处附近的酒吧。

senses.def: a branch of a trade/labor union
a bus or train that stops at all places on the route
senses.chn: （沿线每站都停的）公共汽车，火车

senses.def: the organization which is responsible for the government of an area in Britain
a high-speed data connection that directly links computer devices to the processor and memory
senses.chn: 本地总线，本机汇流排（将计算机设备直接连接到处理器和存储器的高速数据连接）

senses.def: a telephone call to a place that is near
the typical things, customs, etc. in a place that make it interesting, and that are used in a picture, story or film/movie to make it seem real
senses.chn: （文艺作品的）地方特色，乡土色彩

senses.def: a place where sth happens
the system of government of a town or an area by elected representatives of the people who live there
the organization that is responsible for the government of a local area and for providing services, etc.

ex.en: state and local governments
ex.cn: 州和地方政府

senses.def: the area that surrounds the place you are in or are talking about

ex.en: people living in the locality of the power station
ex.cn: 居住在发电站周围地区的人

ex.en: There is no airport in the locality.
ex.cn: 这个地区没有机场。

senses.def: the place where sb/sth exists
senses.chn: （某人或某物存在的）地方，地点

ex.en: We talk of the brain as the locality of thought.
ex.cn: 我们把进行思维的地方叫做大脑。

ex.en: The birds are found in over 70 different localities.
ex.cn: 现已发现这种鸟栖息在 70 多个不同的地区。

senses.def: to limit sth or its effects to a particular area
senses.chn: 使局限（于某地区）；使局部化

senses.def: to find out where sth is
senses.chn: 找出…的地点；发现…的位置

ex.en: animals' ability to localize sounds
ex.cn: 动物确定声音发自某地点的能力

senses.def: to make sth suitable for a particular place, area or market
senses.chn: 使适合特定地区（或市场）；使本土化

ex.en: We will localize the app into French, Japanese, and two written forms of Chinese.
ex.cn: 我们会将该应用程序本地化，使其支持法语、日语和两种书写形式的中文。

senses.def: happening within one small area

ex.en: a localized infection (= in one part of the body)
ex.cn: 局部感染

ex.en: localized fighting
ex.cn: 局部战斗

senses.def: the time of day in the particular part of the world that you are talking about

ex.en: We reach Delhi at 2 o'clock local time.
ex.cn: 我们在当地时间 2 时到达德里。

senses.def: to find the exact position of sb/sth
senses.chn: 找出…的准确位置；确定…的准确地点

ex.en: The mechanic located the fault immediately.
ex.cn: 机修工立即找到了出故障的地方。

ex.en: Rescue planes are trying to locate the missing sailors.
ex.cn: 救援飞机正在努力查明失踪水手的下落。

senses.def: to put or build sth in a particular place

ex.en: They located their headquarters in Swindon.
ex.cn: 他们把总部设在了斯温登。

senses.def: to start a business in a particular place

ex.en: There are tax breaks for businesses that locate in rural areas.
ex.cn: 在农村地区创办企业享有税收减免。

senses.def: if sth is located in a particular place, it exists there or has been put there

ex.en: a small town located 30 miles south of Chicago
ex.cn: 位于芝加哥以南 30 英里的一个小镇

ex.en: The offices are conveniently located just a few minutes from the main station.
ex.cn: 办事处所处的位置很方便，离总站仅有几分钟的路。

senses.def: a place where sth happens or exists; the position of sth

ex.en: a honeymoon in a secret location
ex.cn: 在一个秘密地点度的蜜月

ex.en: What is the exact location of the ship?
ex.cn: 那条船的确切位置在哪里？

ex.en: This would be a good place for a picnic.
ex.cn: 这可是个野餐的好地方。

ex.en: They've chosen a site for the new school.
ex.cn: 他们为新学校选了校址。

ex.en: the hotel reception area
ex.cn: 旅馆接待处

ex.en: Move the cursor to a blank area on the screen.
ex.cn: 把光标移至电脑屏幕的空白区。

senses.def: a place outside a film studio where scenes of a film/movie are made

ex.en: The village was used as the location for a popular TV series.
ex.cn: 这个村庄被用作一部热门电视剧集的外景地。

ex.en: The movie was shot entirely on location in Italy.
ex.cn: 这部影片的外景全是在意大利拍摄的。

senses.def: the act of finding the position of sb/sth
the form of a noun, pronoun or adjective when it expresses the idea of place
senses.chn: （名词、代词或形容词）表示位置的

senses.def: a device or system for finding sth

ex.en: The company lists 5 000 stores on the store locator part of its website.
ex.cn: 这家公司在其网站的商店定位系统部分列出了 5 000 家商店。

senses.def: a lake or a narrow strip of sea almost surrounded by land
to fasten sth with a lock; to be fastened with a lock

ex.en: Did you lock the door?
ex.cn: 你锁门了吗？

ex.en: This suitcase doesn't lock.
ex.cn: 这手提箱锁不上。

senses.def: to put sth in a safe place and lock it

ex.en: She locked her passport and money in the safe.
ex.cn: 她把自己的护照和钱锁在了保险柜里。

senses.def: to become or make sth become fixed in one position and unable to move

ex.en: The brakes locked and the car skidded.
ex.cn: 汽车刹车抱死，车打滑了。

ex.en: He locked his helmet into position with a click.
ex.cn: 他咔哒一声把头盔扣好。

senses.chn: 陷入，卷入（困境、争论、争执等）

ex.en: The two sides are locked into a bitter dispute.
ex.cn: 双方陷入了激烈的争论。

ex.en: She felt locked in a loveless marriage.
ex.cn: 她觉得自己陷入了一桩没有爱情的婚姻。

senses.def: to be held very tightly by sb

ex.en: They were locked in a passionate embrace.
ex.cn: 他们热烈地拥抱在一起。

senses.def: to prevent computer data from being changed or looked at by sb without permission

ex.en: These files are locked to protect confidentiality.
ex.cn: 为了保密，这些文件都加了锁。

senses.def: to get involved in an argument or a disagreement with sb
senses.chn: 涉及（与某人的）争论（或争端、纠纷）

ex.en: The company has locked horns with the unions over proposed pay cuts.
ex.cn: 公司与工会就减薪计划争论不休。

senses.def: to prevent sb from leaving a place by locking the door
senses.chn: 把…锁在屋里；把…关押起来

ex.en: At 9 p.m. the prisoners are locked in for the night.
ex.cn: 晚上 9 点犯人被关进牢房里过夜。

senses.def: to find the thing that is being attacked and follow it
to prevent sb from entering a place by locking the door

ex.en: I'd locked myself out of the house and had to break a window to get in.
ex.cn: 我把自己锁在了门外，不得不破窗而入。

senses.def: to refuse to allow workers into their place of work until they agree to particular conditions
senses.chn: （在工人答应某些条件前）不准进入工作场地

senses.def: to make a building safe by locking the doors and windows

ex.en: Don't forget to lock up at night.
ex.cn: 晚上别忘了锁好门窗。

ex.en: He locked up the shop and went home.
ex.cn: 他锁好商店的门窗后回家了。

senses.def: to put sb in prison
to put sth in a safe place that can be locked
to put money into an investment that you cannot easily turn into cash
senses.chn: 把（钱）搁死（成为不易兑现的资本）

ex.en: Their capital is all locked up in property.
ex.cn: 他们把所有资金都搁死在地产上了。

senses.def: a device that keeps a door, window, lid, etc. shut, usually needing a key to open it

ex.en: She turned the key in the lock.
ex.cn: 她转动锁眼里的钥匙。

senses.def: a device with a key that prevents a vehicle or machine from being used
senses.chn: 车锁；制动器；锁定器；制轮楔

ex.en: a bicycle lock
ex.cn: 自行车的车锁

ex.en: a steering lock
ex.cn: 转向锁

senses.def: a state in which the parts of a machine, etc. do not move
the amount that the front wheels can be turned in one direction or the other in order to turn the vehicle

ex.en: I had the steering wheel on full lock (= I had turned it as far as it would turn).
ex.cn: 我把方向盘转到了底。

senses.def: a section of canal or river with a gate at either end, in which the water level can be changed so that boats can move from one level of the canal or river to another
a few hairs that hang or lie together on your head

ex.en: John brushed a lock of hair from his eyes.
ex.cn: 约翰撩开眼前的一绺头发。

senses.def: a person's hair

ex.en: She shook her long, flowing locks.
ex.cn: 她甩了甩她那飘逸的长发。

senses.def: a player in the second row of the scrum
senses.chn: （并列争球的）第二排前锋，锁球队员

senses.def: total control of sth

ex.en: One company had a virtual lock on all orange juice sales in the state.
ex.cn: 有一家公司实际上垄断了整个州的橙汁销售。

senses.def: including everything

ex.en: He sold the business lock, stock and barrel.
ex.cn: 他把生意全盘卖掉了。

senses.def: locked up safely somewhere; in prison
senses.chn: 把…安全地锁起来；在押；被囚禁

ex.en: We keep our valuables under lock and key.
ex.cn: 我们把贵重物品锁起来收好了。

ex.en: I will not rest until the murderer is under lock and key.
ex.cn: 杀人凶手一天不关起来我一天不罢休。

senses.def: to open a lock without a key, using sth such as a piece of wire
that you can lock with a key
an official order to control the movement of people or vehicles because of a dangerous situation
senses.chn: （对人或交通工具的）活动限制，行动限制

ex.en: a three-day lockdown of American airspace
ex.cn: 美国为期三天的领空关闭

ex.en: Prisoners have been placed on lockdown to prevent further violence at the jail.
ex.cn: 已对囚犯实行活动限制，以免狱中再出现暴力行为。

senses.def: a medical condition, usually resulting from a stroke, in which the person is conscious but unable to feel or move the body and most of the muscles in the face
senses.chn: 闭锁综合征（患者意识清醒，但身体和脸部肌肉失去知觉且难以动弹，通常为脑卒中后遗症）

senses.def: a small cupboard that can be locked, where you can leave your clothes, bags, etc. while you play a sport or go somewhere
senses.chn: （体育馆等的）有锁存物柜，寄存柜

senses.def: a room with lockers in it, at a school, gym, etc., where people can change their clothes
senses.chn: （学校、体育馆等设有锁柜的）更衣室，衣物间

senses.def: a piece of jewellery in the form of a small case that you wear on a chain around your neck and in which you can put a picture, piece of hair, etc.
senses.chn: 盒式项链坠（可放照片、头发等）

senses.def: an occasion when customers are locked in a bar or club after it has closed so that they can continue drinking privately
senses.chn: （酒吧或夜总会打烊后）留置顾客续饮

senses.def: a form of the disease tetanus in which the jaws become stiff and closed
a person who is in charge of a lock on a canal or river, and opens and closes the gates
senses.chn: （运河或河流上的）船闸管理员

senses.def: to find the thing that is being attacked and follow it
a situation when an employer refuses to allow workers into their place of work until they agree to various conditions
senses.chn: 闭厂，停工（雇主在工人答应各种条件前不准其进入工作场地）

senses.def: to refuse to allow workers into their place of work until they agree to particular conditions
senses.chn: （在工人答应某些条件前）不准进入工作场地

senses.def: a person whose job is making, fitting and repairing locks
a way of walking together where people move their feet at the same time

ex.en: The coffin was carried by six soldiers walking in lockstep.
ex.cn: 灵柩由齐步行进的六名士兵抬着。

ex.en: Politicians and the media are marching in lockstep on this issue (= they agree).
ex.cn: 政界和媒体在这一问题上保持一致。

senses.def: a situation where things happen at the same time or change at the same rate

ex.en: a lockstep approach to teaching
ex.cn: 使学生齐头并进的教学方法

ex.en: Cases of breathing difficulties increase in lockstep with air pollution.
ex.cn: 呼吸困难的病例随空气污染的加剧而增加。

senses.def: to make a building safe by locking the doors and windows

ex.en: Don't forget to lock up at night.
ex.cn: 晚上别忘了锁好门窗。

ex.en: He locked up the shop and went home.
ex.cn: 他锁好商店的门窗后回家了。

ex.en: His angry refusal to agree raised the temperature of the meeting.
ex.cn: 他愤然拒不同意，使得会议的气氛紧张起来。

senses.def: to be dark and threatening

example.en: He had to lower his head to get through the door.
example.cn: 他得低头才能过这道门。

example.en: They lowered him down the cliff on a rope.
example.cn: 他们用绳索把他放下悬崖。

ex.cn: 正文一律用小写字体。

ex.cn: 小写字母

senses.chn: （英国）下议院，平民院；（美国）众议院

senses.chn: 低年级学校，低年级班（学生年龄通常在 11 至 14 岁之间）

ex.cn: 在目前的经济气候下，我们可能需要降低配额标准。

senses.def: the smallest number that the bottom numbers of a group of fractions can be divided into exactly

something that is simple enough to seem interesting to, or to be understood by, the highest number of people in a particular group; the sort of people who are least intelligent or accept sth that is of low quality
senses.chn: 大众化的东西；最平庸的人

ex.en: The school syllabus seems aimed at the lowest common denominator.
ex.cn: 学校的教学大纲似乎是针对接受能力最差的学生制订的。

senses.def: the smallest number that a group of numbers can be divided into exactly

of low quality

ex.cn: 低强度有氧运动

ex.cn: 对环境负面影响甚小的旅游业

an area of land that is fairly flat and not very high above sea level

ex.cn: 苏格兰低地

close to the ground

a low building with only a few floors

smoked salmon (= a type of fish)

ex.en: a loyal friend/supporter
ex.cn: 忠实的朋友／支持者

ex.cn: 她总是信守自己的政治原则。

senses.def: a person who is loyal to the ruler or government, or to a political party, especially during a time of change
senses.chn: （尤指在变动时期对统治者、政府或政党）忠诚的人

senses.def: a person who supports the union between Great Britain and Northern Ireland
senses.chn: 支持大不列颠和北爱尔兰联合的人

senses.def: the quality of being faithful in your support of sb/sth

ex.en: They swore their loyalty to the king.
ex.cn: 他们宣誓效忠国王。

ex.cn: 我能指望你对我忠诚吗？

ex.cn: 两面效忠

senses.def: the abbreviation for 'liquefied petroleum gas' (a fuel which is a mixture of gases kept in a liquid form by the pressure in a container)

senses.def: (in Britain and some other countries) a white sign with a large red letter L on it, that you put on a car when you are learning to drive

Law School Admission Test (a test taken by students who want to study law in the US)

senses.chn: 麦角酰二乙胺；迷幻药；致幻药

ex.en: Lt (Helen) Brown
ex.cn: （海伦 ·）布朗陆军中尉

senses.def: Limited (used after the name of a British company or business)
senses.chn: 有限责任公司，股份有限公司（用于英国公司或商行名称之后）

ex.en: Pearce and Co. Ltd
ex.cn: 皮尔斯有限公司

senses.def: the abbreviation for 'long-term evolution' (an international system for digital communication using mobile/cell phones on which the Internet can be accessed at high speeds)
senses.chn: 长期演进（全写为 long-term evolution，应用于手机高速数据传输的国际标准）

senses.def: a city in the US state of Texas
senses.chn: 拉伯克（美国得克萨斯州城市）

to put a lubricant on sth such as the parts of a machine, to help them move smoothly
showing a great interest in sex in a way that is considered unpleasant or unacceptable
clearly expressed; easy to understand

ex.en: a lucid style/explanation
ex.cn: 明白易懂的风格；清楚的解释

senses.def: able to think clearly, especially during or after a period of illness or confusion
senses.chn: （尤指生病期间或病愈后，糊涂状态中或过后）头脑清晰的，清醒的

ex.en: In a rare lucid moment, she looked at me and smiled.
ex.cn: 在难得清醒的时刻，她看看我，笑了笑。

senses.def: the Devil
good things that happen to you by chance, not because of your own efforts or abilities

ex.en: With (any) luck, we'll be home before dark.
ex.cn: 如果一切顺利的话，我们可在天黑前回到家。

ex.en: With a bit of luck, we'll finish on time.
ex.cn: 如果我们运气好，就能够准时完成。

ex.en: So far I have had no luck with finding a job.
ex.cn: 我找工作一直不走运。

ex.en: I could hardly believe my luck when he said yes.
ex.cn: 听他说行，我几乎不敢相信自己会这么走运。

ex.en: It was a stroke of luck that we found you.
ex.cn: 真巧我们找到了你。

ex.en: By sheer luck nobody was hurt in the explosion.
ex.cn: 万幸的是，没有人在爆炸中受伤。

senses.def: chance; the force that causes good or bad things to happen to people

ex.en: to have good/bad luck
ex.cn: 运气好；运气坏

ex.en: This ring has always brought me good luck.
ex.cn: 这戒指总是给我带来好运。

ex.en: The results could simply be due to chance.
ex.cn: 这结果可能纯属意外。

ex.en: They met through a series of strange coincidences.
ex.cn: 他们因一连串奇妙的巧合而相遇。

ex.en: Their early arrival was just an accident.
ex.cn: 他们早到仅仅是偶然而已。

ex.en: Fate decreed that she would never reach America.
ex.cn: 命中注定她永远到不了美国。

senses.def: used to ask sb if they have been successful with sth

ex.en: 'Any luck?' 'No, they're all too busy to help.'
ex.cn: “运气怎么样？” “不怎么样，他们都没空帮忙。”

senses.def: in the way that chance decides what will happen

ex.en: As luck would have it, the train was late.
ex.cn: 不巧火车晚点了。

senses.def: used to express sympathy for sb

ex.en: Bad luck, Helen, you played very well.
ex.cn: 海伦，你表现得非常好，只是运气欠佳。

ex.en: It's hard luck on him that he wasn't chosen.
ex.cn: 他未被选中真是不幸。

senses.def: to have no money because of a period of bad luck
senses.chn: 因一时不走运而没有钱；穷困潦倒

senses.def: used to wish sb success with sth

ex.en: The best of luck with your exams.
ex.cn: 祝你考试成功！

ex.en: Good luck! I hope it goes well.
ex.cn: 祝你交好运！我希望这事进展顺利。

senses.def: used to encourage sb who has not been successful at sth
senses.chn: （鼓励未成功的人）祝下次好运

senses.def: because you believe it will bring you good luck, or because this is a traditional belief
senses.chn: 图个吉利；为了带来好运

ex.en: Take something blue. It's for luck.
ex.cn: 挑件蓝色的东西吧，求个吉利。

senses.def: for no particular reason

ex.en: I hit him once more for luck.
ex.cn: 我无故又打了他一下。

senses.def: used to say that you do not mind what sb does as it does not affect you, but you hope they will be successful
senses.chn: （与己无关而不介意某人的所为）祝某人成功，祝某人走运

ex.en: It's not something I would care to try myself but if she wants to, good luck to her.
ex.cn: 这件事我自己是不想做的，但如果她想试一试，祝愿她成功。

senses.def: used to show you are not surprised sth bad has happened to you, because you are not often lucky
senses.chn: （对自己的遭遇并不惊讶）常不走运，就这运气

ex.en: Just my luck to arrive after they had left.
ex.cn: 我总是这样倒霉，他们离去后我才赶到。

senses.def: used to say that sb has been lucky or successful
the fact that chance decides sth, in a way that you cannot control

senses.chn: （所希望的事情没有发生而失望）没那么走运

senses.def: used as a way of saying that you are sorry about sth, usually ironically(= you really mean the opposite)
senses.chn: （常作反话）太不幸了，真够倒霉

ex.en: It's pot luck whether you get good advice or not.
ex.cn: 能不能得到好的指点那就全靠运气了。

ex.en: You're welcome to stay to supper, but you'll have to take pot luck (= eat whatever is available).
ex.cn: 欢迎你留下来吃晚饭，不过你得有什么就吃什么了。

senses.chn: （由于过去的成功过关）再冒一次险，继续碰运气

ex.en: You didn't get caught last time, but don't push your luck!
ex.cn: 上次没被逮住，但你不要再心存侥幸了！

ex.en: 'I failed by one point.' 'That's tough luck.'
ex.cn: “我差一分没及格。” “运气真不好。”

ex.en: 'If you take the car, I won't be able to go out.' 'Tough luck!'
ex.cn: “如果你把车开走，我就出不去了。” “该你倒霉！”

senses.def: to do sth that involves risk or luck, hoping to succeed

ex.en: My grandparents emigrated to Canada to try their luck there.
ex.cn: 我的祖父母移民到加拿大去碰碰运气。

senses.def: used to show that you are disappointed about sth

ex.en: I shall have to miss the party, worse luck!
ex.cn: 我参加不了这次聚会了，真倒霉！

senses.def: to be lucky

ex.en: I guess I really lucked out when I met her.
ex.cn: 我想，我遇到她真是交了好运。

senses.def: having bad luck
senses.chn: 运气不好的；不走运的；不幸的

ex.en: the luckless victim of the attack
ex.cn: 遭到袭击的不幸受害者

senses.def: to be lucky

ex.en: I guess I really lucked out when I met her.
ex.cn: 我想，我遇到她真是交了好运。

senses.def: having good luck
senses.chn: 有好运的；运气好的；幸运的

ex.en: His friend was killed and he knows he is lucky to be alive.
ex.cn: 他的朋友丧了命，他知道自己还活着是侥幸。

ex.en: She was lucky enough to be chosen for the team.
ex.cn: 她很幸运被选中参加此队。

ex.en: You were lucky (that) you spotted the danger in time.
ex.cn: 幸好你及时发现了险情。

ex.en: You can think yourself lucky you didn't get mugged.
ex.cn: 你未遭暴力抢劫，可算是万幸了。

ex.en: She counted herself lucky that she still had a job.
ex.cn: 她认为自己很幸运，仍有一份工作。

ex.en: Mark is one of the lucky ones —he at least has somewhere to sleep.
ex.cn: 马克是个幸运的人，他至少还有地方睡觉。

senses.def: being the result of good luck

ex.en: It was lucky for us that we were able to go.
ex.cn: 我们能去是我们的运气好。

ex.en: That was the luckiest escape of my life.
ex.cn: 那次逃脱是我一生中最大的幸运。

ex.en: a lucky guess
ex.cn: 侥幸猜中

senses.def: bringing good luck

ex.en: a lucky charm
ex.cn: 吉祥配饰

senses.def: used to show that you think sb is lucky to have sth, be able to do sth, etc.

ex.en: 'I'm off to Paris.' 'Lucky you!'
ex.cn: “我要去巴黎了。” “你真幸运！”

senses.chn: （告诉某人所期盼的事很可能不会发生）但愿你会走运

ex.en: 'I was hoping to get a ticket for Saturday.' 'You'll be lucky.'
ex.cn: “我盼望弄到一张星期六的票。” “但愿你会走运。”

senses.def: used to tell sb that they will probably not get what they are hoping for, and may not deserve it
senses.chn: （告诉某人所希望之物可能得不到，且本不该其得到）你不见得这么走运吧

senses.def: to have good luck
to feel very grateful and lucky about sth
used when you have failed to do sth twice and hope that you will succeed the third time
senses.chn: （但愿）第三次交好运；过一过二不过三

example.en: His friend was killed and he knows he is lucky to be alive.
example.cn: 他的朋友丧了命，他知道自己还活着是侥幸。

example.en: You were lucky (that) you spotted the danger in time.
example.cn: 幸好你及时发现了险情。

example.en: Luckily for us, the train was late.
example.cn: 我们真凑巧，火车晚点了。

senses.def: a game in which people choose a present from a container of presents without being able to see what it is going to be
producing a large amount of money; making a large profit

ex.en: a lucrative business/contract/market
ex.cn: 利润丰厚的生意／合同／市场

ex.en: The play was very successful on Broadway.
ex.cn: 那出剧在百老汇大获成功。

ex.en: The company has had another successful year.
ex.cn: 公司又度过了一个兴旺发达之年。

ex.en: a highly profitable business
ex.cn: 一家赢利很高的企业

ex.en: The movie was not a commercial success(= made no profit).
ex.cn: 这部电影票房收入不佳。

ex.en: They do a lot of business in lucrative overseas markets.
ex.cn: 他们在利润丰厚的海外市场上生意很多。

senses.def: money, especially when it has been obtained in a way that is dishonest or immoral

ex.en: the lure of filthy lucre
ex.cn: 不义之财的诱惑

senses.chn: 反对新技术（或新工作方法）的人

senses.def: showing a tendency to play and have fun, make jokes, etc., especially when there is no particular reason for doing this
unreasonable; that you cannot take seriously

ex.en: a ludicrous suggestion
ex.cn: 荒谬的建议

ex.en: It was ludicrous to think that the plan could succeed.
ex.cn: 认为此计划会取得成功是荒唐的。

senses.def: a simple game played with dice and counters on a special board, similar to the American game, Parcheesi
senses.chn: 卢多（一种用骰子和筹码在棋盘上玩的游戏，类似于美国的巴棋戏）

senses.chn: 吃力地搬运；用力拖；使劲拉

ex.en: I had to lug my bags up to the fourth floor.
ex.cn: 我只得费劲地把我的几个包拖上五楼。

senses.def: a part of sth that sticks out, used as a handle or support
an ear
a type of sledge (= a vehicle for sliding over ice) for racing, used by one or two people lying on their back with their feet pointing forwards
senses.chn: 无舵雪橇，单雪橇（比赛用的单人或双人仰卧雪橇）

senses.def: the event or sport of racing down a track of ice on a luge
senses.chn: 无舵雪橇运动；单雪橇运动

senses.def: bags, cases, etc. that contain sb's clothes and things when they are travelling

ex.en: There's room for one more piece of luggage.
ex.cn: 还有地方再放一件行李。

ex.cn: 你看着行李，我去找出租车。

ex.en: Do you have a lot of luggage?
ex.cn: 你的行李多吗？

ex.en: Two pieces of luggage have gone missing.
ex.cn: 有两件行李丢失了。

ex.en: Never leave baggage unattended.
ex.cn: 切勿丢下行李不管。

senses.def: a shelf for luggage above the seats in a train, bus, etc.
senses.chn: （火车、公共汽车等座位上方的）行李架

senses.def: a coach/car on a train for carrying passengers' luggage
sad and serious

ex.en: a lugubrious expression
ex.cn: 悲伤的神情

senses.def: a large worm are often used as bait that lives in the sand by the sea. Lugworms are often used as bait on a hook to catch fish.
senses.chn: 海蚯蚓，沙蠋（常用作钓饵）

senses.def: slightly warm
senses.chn: 微温的；不冷不热的；温和的

ex.en: Our food was only lukewarm.
ex.cn: 我们的食物只是温乎的。

ex.en: I'm cold. Turn the heating up.
ex.cn: 我觉得冷，把暖气温度调高一点。

ex.en: Outside it was bitterly cold.
ex.cn: 外面非常寒冷。
